title: Beauty puzzle
description: A puzzle game in which you need to connect the pieces in a line. To successfully complete the game, it is important to use its mechanics to your advantage

title: Demolition Derby Derby
description: Welcome to Demolition Derby the mobile sensation where you control the chaos! Strategically tap to toss dynamite and swipe to send rocks crashing down. Decimate buildings and statues with precision in this hyper-casual game.

title: Horror Forest Bear
description: Imagine an angry bear that has escaped from its cave in the forest. It's very hungry and wants to eat honey. You must help the bear. The bear is starving, and it needs to eat all the honey. You need to be very careful—it's a dark and dangerous forest, full of traps and hunters. The hunters have become much stronger because they can shoot with guns now. You must avoid the hunters. Escape from them, collect all the honey, and return to the bear's cave.

title: Mahjong Match
description: Immerse yourself in our brain games, each level waiting for your mahjong match strategic touch. Your objective? Match three mahjongs of the same color to clear the board puzzle. With every  level presenting an array of mahjong tiles and brain games, the excitement of puzzle games will never wane.

title: Single Stroke Line Draw
description:
Single Stroke Draw Line is a puzzle game with with one touch line drawing. It is required for you to draw one line to connect all the points without any route repetition.
- The rule is very simple, Draw given figures with only one touch.
- Explore amazing levels of this puzzle at your fingertips and sharpen your brain IQ & skills.
- Game level starts with very easy levels and increases in difficultly as you progress in the game.

title: Sword Run 3D
description: Sword Run 3D is an easy to pick up action runner game. Collect sword pieces, cut off the obstacles that block your progress, and finally reach the finish line to win. More cool skins are waiting for you to unlock, what are you waiting for? Don't forget to share it with your friends if it's fun!

title: Idle Legend
description: Dive into an exciting world! Fight monsters, gather battle energy, unlock bosses, and defeat them to earn coins. Spend coins on upgrades, skins, and pets. Enjoy vibrant cartoon graphics and exciting quests. Start your adventure today!

title: BouncePop Quest
description: Guide Jumpo, a squishy and color-changing jelly creature, through over 150 vibrant levels filled with tricky obstacles, moving platforms, and environmental hazards. Charge and release powerful jumps to collect stars, dodge enemies, and unlock new worlds—from the icy peaks to fiery lava lands. Master timing, aim for achievements, and power up in this cute, bouncy adventure!

title: Squid Escape Game
description: You must escape from this iron-covered labyrinth prison. Both blue players need to escape the prison. You must collect all the geometric shapes. Collect all the shapes and find both keys. Find the keys and run to the door. Be very careful, there are thorny obstacles on the ground. Don't stray too far from your friend; if you lose each other, you will lose the game.

title: Little Lily Halloween Prep
description: Welcome to Little Lily Halloween Prep. It’s time to celebrate Halloween with Little Lily! Enjoy a memorable Halloween night with Lily and play fun-packed Halloween games and activities. Help the lily to complete her makeover, then help her with Halloween face painting. Browse her wardrobe and pick cute outfits and costumes. Finally, help her with cake decoration. A lot more to enjoy and explore this Halloween season with Little Lily. Happy Halloween!!

title: Puzzle Blocks Asmr Match
description:
Puzzle Blocks ASMR Match is a block puzzle game that combines classics with innovation. It is different from the block jigsaw games and brick puzzle games you usually play. This game uses a
real physics engine. After the bottom blocks are eliminated, the upper bricks will automatically fall down, which makes the game more difficult. In the game, you cannot rotate the blocks to make
them fit more gaps, which means that you often only have one chance.

title: Cannon Shooter
description: Cannon Shooter is an exciting arcade shooter where you can have endless shooting fun in fast-paced combat! You will control a cannonball firing hordes of heroic characters, facing many enemies. A quick click to launch more heroes and help you generate more heroes through the digital gate.

title: Skibronx Runner
description: Make your way through the streets in this endless runner game while you encounter various challenges. In the level mode its your goal to reach the grocery store without losing. In the endless mode your goal is to reach as far as possible without losing.

title: Roblo X Zombie
description: Get ready for an intense solo survival experience in Zombie Defense Builder! As the last survivor, you must gather supplies, scavenge for collectibles, and build strong defenses to hold off waves of relentless zombies. In this action-packed, strategic game, every second counts. Gather materials, craft powerful barricades, and upgrade your defenses before the next wave hits. Can you survive the apocalypse and fend off the undead for as long as possible

title: Smash The Bottle
description: Bottle Smash Arcade is a fun, casual arcade smash game where you shatter bottles in wild combos—perfect for fans of cool math games and Roblox-style thrills. Master quick reflexes like in Minecraft challenge levels, or go old-school with snake game breaks. Upgrade bottle-breaking action, smash for points, crush boredom Kahoot-style in this playful, fast-paced smash-the-bottle adventure!

title: Farm Block
description: Farm Block is an engaging farm-themed puzzle game where players slide adorable animal blocks to free them from the farm. Test your strategic thinking and enjoy the charming countryside setting! With its mix of puzzle-solving and elimination mechanics, Farm Block offers a fun and rewarding challenge for all ages.

title: Doge Rush Draw Home Puzzle
description: Welcome to Doge Rush: Draw Home Puzzle! It's full of lovely adventures. There are two ways to play this game. In the Animal family party, you should help the dog and cat find their food and guide them home, drawing a line between the dog and cat's correct food. And avoid them bumping into each other. If they hit, they will get dizzy and the game will fail.

title: Kitty Couple Lovely Valentine
description: Celebrate love with the adorable kitty duo Angela and Tom in Kitty Couple Lovely Valentine. This charming game takes players on a delightful journey filled with fashion, hidden surprises, and puzzles. Help the cute couple prepare for their special Valentine’s Day by dressing them up, uncovering hidden hearts, and completing their couple photo puzzle.

title: Planet Merge
description:
Embark on an interstellar journey in the most thrilling puzzle game of 2025! Merge planets in a cosmic challenge and create a universe of fun.
imple Yet Addictive Gameplay: Just drag and release to align the planets. Watch as they combine into spectacular new celestial bodies.

title: Data Diggers
description:
Merge USBs, choose blocks, download data, get money,and buy USBs
Merge the USBs for increased efficiency.

Dig Data in Data Diggers, actually you rather download Data with your USBs.
The higher the GB amount of your USB, the faster you can download the data.

title: Tip Tap!
description:
Get ready for a challenging and fun physics-based skill game where your goal is simple: move either the dynamic plate or the ball to reach the emoji smiley and complete the level without falling off the edge?

Key Features
-50+ skill-challenging levels that ramp up in difficulty as you progress
-Physics-based gameplay that tests your precision and timing
-Dynamic controls: move the plate or the ball to reach the goal

title: Save Baby Capybaras - Pull Pin
description:
“Save Baby Capybaras - Pull Pin” is a cute puzzle game where you must figure out which pins to pull in order to rescue the baby capybaras and bring them to their father capybara. Be strategic, as some pins don’t need to be pulled, while others can disrupt your game. Unlock character skins using the rubies you earn and challenge yourself across various levels!
Enjoy the game and raise your name on the global leaderboard!

title: Block Craft 3D School
description: Welcome to Block Craft 3D-School. Here creativity meets adventure! In this pixel-style game, you will enter a world of endless possibilities, like Minecraft. To build and protect your school using blocks of various shapes! But be careful that this isn't just a building game! Enemies hide anywhere and are ready to hit you! Besides, collect and place blocks.

title: Going Balls Adventure 2
description: Going Balls Adventure 2 is a ball-rolling arcade game with a 3D game engine. Your main mission is to collect black balls and reach the checkpoint. Your side mission is to collect all coins on the platform. It doesn't matter if you don't fish the job. Before the level begins, you have a chance to try some free skins for you to decide on a favorite one.

title: Merge the Coins USSR!
description: ● Game in an unusual setting! Compete with friends and colleagues?! In the game you have a playing area? where coins fall and are connected if they are the same! Connect as many coins as possible to make the biggest one, save up points?! Be the first on the leaderboard?! Play and relax ?!

title: Volley Bean
description: Volley Bean is a simple and easy to learn volleyball game. With simple controls and fast paced gameplay volleyball never been more entertaining. The variety of boosts spawn randomly on the screen doubles the fun.

title: Disk Rush
description: Disk Rush is a reaction-based arcade game where players must quickly sort colored disks into their matching zones. The game challenges your speed and accuracy as disks appear faster over time. With simple tap mechanics and increasing difficulty, Disk Rush tests your ability to think and act quickly under pressure.

title: Emoji Challenge
description: Emoji Challenge is an engaging skill game. Featuring levels constructed entirely with popular emojis. The game offers six distinct puzzle types: link puzzle, memory puzzle, word quiz, related puzzle, shadow puzzle, and crop puzzle. This game is perfect for players who enjoy brain teasers and want to test their problem-solving skills.

title: Upgrade the Supercar 3D
description: Upgrade The Supercar 3D is a casual arcade game where you move along a track to deck out your car step by step, or rather, obstacle by obstacle. Race through colorful levels, collect upgrades, and customize your ride with new paint, wheels, and body kits as you go.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Merge Blocks 2048 Style!
description: ● A game with a summer atmosphere! Compete with friends and colleagues?! In the game you have a playing area? where cubes fall and merge if they have the same number! Merge as many cubes as possible to make the biggest one, save up points?! Be the first on the leaderboard?! Play and relax ?!

title: Rift of Hell-Demons War
description:
Hordes of insidious demons are lurking in the hellish catacombs! Can you challenge hundreds of hellish creatures and destroy them all as you descend closer to the citadel?
You have several types of weapons at your disposal and an almost endless supply of ammo along the way!
With each step, collecting gold that falls from enemies, you will become stronger and stronger, strength, speed of movement, arsenal of deadly weapons, armor - all this will depend on your actions.

title: Sprunki Challenge
description: Sprunki Challenge game adds a challenge mode to the famous Sprunki game and activates the game's battle mode. While the 1 Player mode of the game includes the classic mode, in the 2 Player mode you both make music using Sprunki characters and try to reach 2000 by generating scores. You can play the game with your friend in both dark mode and normal mode. If you want, you can also activate different backgrounds.

title: Survival Island
description:
Hey kids! Are you ready for a thrilling island survival adventure? In Survival Island, you’ll explore a mysterious island full of surprises! Cut down trees with your axe, mine rocks, gather grass, and fish to keep your energy up. Produce food to stay strong and upgrade your skills to survive longer.

Whether it’s day, night, or stormy, anything can happen! Explore caves, swim, and boost your speed and capacity. Get ready for a fun-filled survival journey in Survival Island!

title: Dolphin Dash
description: Launch your dolphin out of the water and smash through obstacles in this fast-paced underwater adventure. Collect coins, defeat bosses, and explore colorful ocean worlds full of surprises!

title: Stunt Bike Rider Bros
description: Stunt Bike Rider Bros is a motorcycle racing and show game that you can play in both 1 player and 2 player mode with your friend. There are 3 different game modes in the game. In the "Racing Mode", you can compete with both your friend and other motorcycle drivers. In the "Career Mode", try to complete the difficult stages in a limited time. In the "Open World", you can earn coins and diamonds by performing various stunts with your motorcycles.

title: Dog Merge Mania
description: Merge cute puppies! Unlock breeds & grow your own fluffy dog paradise! A Relaxing Escape: The perfect mix of chill gameplay and light strategy.

title: Queen of Mahjong
description:
Plunge into the atmosphere of a magical world in a new game in the style of Mahjong Connect. Discover several worlds of objects by finding identical pairs of different items!

Queen of Mahjong is an amazing game that will give you moments of pleasure.

title: Giant Run 3D
description: Giant Run 3D is a boy's free online game. You need to choose the correct doors to gather more people. The more people you collect, the bigger the giant you can merge at the end and the chances of winning will be enlarged. The game will eventually require your people to become a giant so that you can fight to the death with the final boss. Sprint all the way to the finish line to start fighting!

title: Stickman Prison Escape
description: Stickman went back to prison for committing a minor crime. It's time to find a successful way to escape from this cold, gray prison. Guards and other difficulties await you along the way. There will be a choice of 3 items that the guard brought hidden in the pumpkin. It's Halloween time and pumpkin will help Stickman successfully escape prison.

title: Dynamons 10
description: Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 10! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Gold Temple world and the bonus cave. Encounter Tyrexar, Tyceratox, Cobragora, Pterodanox, Knightanyx and the diamond Guardian and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: Food Jam
description: Food Jam is a fun and satisfying puzzle game where you sort fruits, veggies, and drinks into the right takeout carts. With over 500 juicy levels, unlock delicious new themes like desserts and juices! Use unique power-ups to clear tricky jams and keep your customers happy.

title: FPS Toy Realism
description: This new shooter offers a unique experience of team battles on a large 12x12 map. Thanks to the excellent shooting feel and precise shooting mechanics, every shot feels realistic and exciting. The game features a weapon purchasing system similar to popular shooters, allowing you to select and customize your arsenal before the fight for maximum effectiveness. Support items such as medkits and rockets are available to help you quickly restore health or destroy enemies with powerful rocket volleys.

title: Butterfly Kyodai Deluxe 2
description: The beloved classic returns! In Butterfly Kyodai Deluxe 2, connect matching butterflies in this beautifully refreshed game,  featuring new wing colors, enhanced animations, updated UI, and countless levels to complete . Can you clear each level before time runs out? Collect coins to unlock new backgrounds and stunning butterfly wings in the updated shop! A relaxing, fun puzzle for all ages!

title: Stickman battle 1-4 Players
description:
Cool collection of dynamic action games!

Fight with rotating weapons, score goals in football, Take first place in a long race, Complete difficult survival levels and much more.

There is a quick round for a couple of minutes and a tournament for several rounds.

You can play up to 4 players, play with friends and bots.
You can change the player's appearance: change cars, faces, color.

Play and have a lot of fun!

title: Battle Tanks Firestorm
description:
This game has incorporated the best of famous tank games. 
You can choose the tank that you like best, or prefer a more powerful version. Go to the levels and defend your base from the enemy. At your disposal are more than 15 types of tanks with various upgrades: armor, upgrades of the first, second and third levels. These improvements will help you gain an advantage over the enemy tank army.

title: Black Hole: Beauty Makeup
description: Black Hole: Beauty Makeup is a game where the player controls a black hole trying to devour as many objects around it as possible. Eat more, grow more, then create a beauty makeover!  Cool black hole simulator. Absorb different objects. Unlock skins. Do you like black hole and simulators?

title: Mahjong Zen Garden
description:
Do you like relaxing games? Or do you prefer a challenge? Try Mahjong Zen Garden and choose the way you want to play!

*Hone your attention to detail and planning skills in this classic Chinese puzzle game by choosing the best mode for you.
*120 unique campaign levels!
*Show your skills and unlock Endless Mode!
*Unique design with an Eastern atmosphere!

title: Run from Baba Yaga
description:
Run from Baba Yaga is a potentially endless runner in which player has to collect as much treasures as possible and run as long as possible while Baba Yaga is trying to catch up with them.

During the chase, Baba Yaga gradually gets stronger: her movespeed and damage increase.An outstanding result can be achieved if player reaches the last stage of the game by running 400 hexes (hexagonal pieces of path).

title: Sandwich Runner
description: Sandwich Runner is a fun game. Collect ingredients on the way to the goal, how high will it reach? The diner is very hungry and he can't wait to eat. Collect steaks, chicken thighs, fried eggs, and sushi. Be careful to avoid bad food like mold and rot or it will make the diner sick! Red peppers will make the diner spitfire! Can you keep the diner happy and pass the level? Good luck!

title: Parking Fury 3D: Beach City 2
description: Parking Fury 3D: Beach City 2 takes you to a vibrant town by the beach where you can test your driving and parking skills in a variety of supercars. Complete challenging parking missions while exploring the scenic coastal streets. You can switch cars on the map, but watch out for the police - get caught stealing a vehicle, and it’s game over! Can you master the art of parking in Beach City without getting busted?

title: Zombie Raft
description: Zombie Raft is a survival game. The zombie apocalypse is coming and it's time for a raft survival game! Protect yourself and other survivors from the looming zombie tsunami, and push them all back, it's your responsibility to survive on the raft! Squeeze the vehicles forward and push them if necessary! Keep going, escape the zombie tsunami, and conquer the barren land! If stranded survivors are found, you need to rescue them! Join us and experience the best zombie game!

title: ASMR Beauty Homeless
description: One of our patrons came in today with her homeless friend, Anna, who is in need of urgent hygiene care. Let’s assist the doctor in cleaning her body, teeth, and the area around her piercing. After the treatment, style her in the best outfit!

title: Natural disaster survival Obby
description:
Immerse yourself in an exciting Roblox-style adventure with the game “Natural disaster survival Obby”! 

Dynamic maps are waiting for you, where disasters are happening every second - lava flows, floods, tornadoes and much more. Pass the obby trials, dodge the dangers and try to survive the longest! 

Play online with friends and other players from all over the world. 
Unlock stylish skins and unique pets to stand out from the rest.

title: Bolt Climb: Tap to the Top
description: Bolt Climb: Tap to the Top is an addictive one-touch climbing game where you control a cute bolt on a mission to climb as high as possible! Just tap and hold to rise — the higher you go, the harder it gets. Can you set a new record?

title: Ball Eating Simulator
description: Get ready to have a great eating and growing fun under an open sky with cool balls inside different costumes in this great simulator game! Eat as much as balls around and get as much as big in the ball’s arena. Eat others, earn coins, and unlock new skins. Chase after gifts, rotate the lucky spin, or enjoy the everyday gifts to carry your eating simulator experience further. All you want is to become the king of the ball arena with your cool player.

title: Words from Words
description: "Words from Words" is an exciting game, the purpose of which is to create as many different words as possible from the letters given to you. You can create 29 words from the word «example», «maverick» includes 71 words, and "chalkboard" stores as many as 142 words. Can you solve everything?

title: Flick 'n Bounce
description: Tap to bounce enemies, use powerful props, and survive in this fast-paced stickman battle! Don't let enemies get close—bounce them all away and master the chaos! Ready for the challenge?

title: Mahjong Connect Cookware
description: Help your chef to clean his kitchen and remove all cookware by connecting them with a line that can change it's direction no more than 2 times!

title: Incredible Kids Dentist
description: This is a dentist game for kids. Have you ever wanted to be a dentist? If this was your dream before, you should not miss this game. In this educational game, you can become a doctor in a hospital. You need to check the teeth of your patients.

title: Br Br Patapim: Obby Challenge
description: Br Br Patapim: Obby Challenge is a wild meme-fueled obby game where you’ll jump, fall, and laugh your way through chaos! Inspired by the viral spirit of Italian Brainrot Animals of TikTok trends, this game turns parkour madness into pure comedy. Take control of the legendary Brr Brr Patapim and conquer ridiculous levels full of traps, platforms, and meme-powered surprises.

title: Princess Rescue Fruit Connect
description: Begin a fruity puzzle adventure. Princess Rescue Fruit Connect is a delightful match puzzle game where your mission is to rescue a beautiful princess by matching fruits and solving tricky levels. Connect two identical fruits to eliminate them. But notice clearing the board before time runs out. All while progressing to rescue the princess.

title: 100 Doors Puzzle Box
description: The main goal in 100 Doors Puzzle Box is to escape the room. Using all the possibilities you need to open each of 100 doors and move the elevator to the next floor. Search for hidden objects, sovle puzzles and use an items to do this!

title: Load The Dishes ASMR
description:
Load The Dishes ASMR is a puzzle game that puts you in comfort and fun! Your task is to sort different colored dishes and put them in the dishwasher. By organizing your cutlery in an organized way, you will find that this is not just a simple puzzle challenge, but also a super
relaxing ASMR sound experience.

title: Flick Baseball Super Homerun
description:
Experience various baseball pitches based on the pendulum movement. The ball will fly further if you can hit the ball directly with the quick flick. Experience a “real-life like” batting simulation in this baseball game.
# One Flick Easy Control
You only use flick to control the batting for this game. The more accurate you flick your finger to hit the ball; it is more likely that you will be a home-run hitter.

title: Jelly Run 2048
description: Jelly Run 2048 is a challenging casual puzzle game that combines the classic 2048 number merging with exciting parkour gameplay. Guide your jelly block by swiping left or right to connect and disconnect cubes. Merge cubes to get double the number, reaching 2048 or greater. When the jelly block collides with tiles of the same number, they merge into a larger number.

title: Dream Pet Hotel
description: Dream Pet Hotel is a charming connect puzzle game with an engaging hotel meta. Match tiles to clear levels, earn rewards, and unlock cozy rooms. Decorate and furnish spaces to create a unique style, then welcome adorable pets to stay in your hotel. Watch your collection grow as you design the perfect home for cats, dogs, pandas, and more. Relaxing, addictive, and fun to play online — build your dream pet hotel today!

title: Stick - Color War
description:
To defeat enemies you must shoot bullets of the same color as the enemy. 
Every five levels you have to defeat a boss.
Breaking off new weapons.
Will you be able to resist the colored sticks?
Play our shooter without downloads and registration.

title: Craft Man Vs Giant TNT
description: Are you ready to enter a crazy world full of giants and TNT? Craftsman vs Giant TNT is an exciting Minecraft-style game that challenges your creativity, strategy and courage. Play as a brave craftsman in a dangerous world. Choose between two different modes: Destroy TNT or City TNT. Build fortifications and use weapons to repel giant enemies.

title: Superhero Phone Simulator
description: Explore action-packed mini-games, customize your hero, and test your skills in fun challenges. Whether you enjoy racing, creativity, or exciting adventures, this app has everything you need for endless fun!

title: OUTSIDE
description:
OUTSIDE is a sleek and minimal puzzle game where every move matters. Guide a one-eyed character through a grid to collect the key and reach the exit — but there’s a twist: once you start moving, you won’t stop until you hit a wall.

Plan your route carefully, avoid dead ends, and use the environment to your advantage. With simple mechanics and clean visuals, OUTSIDE is easy to pick up but tough to master — a perfect test of logic and spatial thinking.

title: Bricks Breaker. Gravity Balls
description: Use gravity to smash all the blocks on the level with balls! This addictive puzzle game based on realistic physics will test your aiming skills. Get ready to embark on a journey through the world of bouncing balls and breaking bricks!

title: Crazy Plane Landing
description:
Flying is easy - but can you stick the landing?

Get into one of the amazing flying machines and launch as high as you can. This part is easy… well, fairly easy. Not that anyone can do it. But you can. Surely you do!

What’s really interesting is what happens next. Will you crash? Or will you somehow make it a perfect landing?

title: Uphill Rush 13
description: Introducing the new, thirteenth game in the Uphill Rush series, and this time in a new setting - a Water Park! Dive into (pun intended) the atmosphere of water fun, riding different types of tubes, surfboards and even jet skis! Unlock new power-ups and skins by overcoming obstacles, such as loops and long jumps. But don't be scared of them, they are your best friends when it comes to stunts, which give you bonuses! Not to mention, make you look insanely cool.

title: Xiblba Match
description: Xiblba Match Seasons 1 is one of the new Match 3 games from the creators of the SIDM GAMES STUDIO, Xiblba Match Seasons. The most beautiful Xiblba Match. The second sequel features a BIG content update with new levels and a relaxing soundtrack to enjoy!

title: Mahjong Connect Majong Class
description: Mahjong Connect is a classic elimination-style casual game where players need to find and connect identical mahjong tiles on the board. The game rules are simple yet challenging, suitable for players of all ages.

title: LampHead
description: The main character of this game is an amazing man with a lamp instead of a head who needs to get out of a dark and dangerous strange place at any cost. Are you ready to prove that you have an outstanding reaction, maneuvering between sharp obstacles, collecting bonuses, remembering that at the end of each dark path the light of victory awaits you? We are ready to offer you a one-time runner in which tedious jumps are replaced by moving the main character between two equal planes.

title: Cannons Blast 3D
description: Cannons Blast 3D plays like another tower defense puzzle game. With a heavy machine gun and a cannon, you need to eliminate all incoming enemy units before they get close to your castle. Your weapon has limited ammo and reloading speed. It is necessary to make a choice of fire coverage. When you earn enough gems, you can buy the other 2 weapons and upgrade your current ones. It is time to test your shooting skills!

title: Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up
description:
In Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up, you’re dressing up your doll and getting her ready to go live. Pick from different styles—she can look like a fairy, wear chill street clothes, or go for a beach outfit. When you’re done, she jumps on the stream and starts showing off her look.

You can mess with her hair, add makeup, and try out accessories. There’s also a battle mode where you go up against other players to see who styled it best.

title: SuStainable
description: As the watchful guardian of a prestigious museum, you're tasked with protecting the priceless artwork from eco-activists turned vandals. To succeed, you must scour the exhibition halls, gather clues, and apprehend the culprit in the act. Once apprehended, you'll conduct a tense interrogation to uncover the truth. Will you be able to find the incriminating paint bucket before the damage is done, or will the suspect's cunning and your own inexperience lead to a disastrous outcome?

title: Fashion Famous
description: Step into the stylish universe of Fashion Famous! Compete in glamorous fashion contests, pick outfits that match each round’s theme, and impress the judges to earn high scores. Travel across global fashion capitals and showcase your look on dazzling runways. Explore makeup, hairstyles, and accessories to build the perfect outfit. Will your sense of style stand out among players from all around the world?

title: Magical Diary: Paper Dress Up
description: Dress up your paper doll with mystical styles in Magical Diary: Paper Dress Up! ?✨ Get ready to enter a dreamy world where fantasy meets fashion. This isn’t just a dress-up game—it’s your magical escape, where every outfit tells a story and every style reveals a spellbound secret. Whether you're a fashion dreamer, a lover of magic, or a diary keeper at heart, this enchanted adventure is made just for you.

title: Maze Escape : Craft Man
description:
Objective:
Navigate through a series of craft doors and escape the maze without being killed by terrifying entities.

Gameplay:

    Explore the Maze: Move through a maze filled with multiple doors, each leading to new and more challenging areas.
    Survive the Entities: Avoid or outsmart various entities that lurk in the maze, each with unique behaviors and attack patterns.
    Find the Next Door: Continuously search for the next door to progress to subsequent levels of the maze.
    Collect Items: Gather keys to unlock doors, coins for upgrades, and useful tools to aid in your survival.

title: Nuts Stack Sort: Nuts & Bolts
description:
Challenging yet relaxing Nuts & Bolts sort puzzle with a unique twist!

Nuts Stack Sort: Nuts & Bolts is a fun and addictive stack sort puzzle game with a unique twist! Strategically sort and match three same color nuts based on box color in this jam puzzles. Every level offers an exciting challenge in this addictive sort colors puzzle game. Test yourself with this amazing brain teaser!

title: Robby The Lava Tsunami
description:
In this game, you have to get to the finish line and not get caught in the lava tsunami. The game is similar to the popular mode from roblox, but there are unique abilities waiting for you. Use them to be better than your opponents.
This is a game for fans of jumping, speed, parkour.
The game has many skins for your character, and you can also buy a fashionable hat.

title: LinkLink
description:
Round and cute animal blocks are piled up.
If you connect the same types together, you can get points by disappearing!
Let's compete to see who gets the highest score in a minute

title: Merge Squares
description: "Merge Squares" is an exciting puzzle game, where your task is to connect squares with same numbers. Using logic and strategic mind, you have to decide how to arrange the squares to combine them into one. Each level gets harder, how far can you go?

title: Pizza Tycoon
description: Play as Boss Hei Wa, running a pizza shop! Serve food, collect payments, hire and upgrade staff, and expand sales channels. Manage and grow your business to success!

title: Animal Block Pop Puzzle
description: Animal Block Pop Puzzle is a fun puzzle game with cute animal-themed visuals. ??✨ Match 3+ animal-shaped blocks ?? on a grid to clear them and score points. As you progress, the game gets faster and adds new tile colors for a growing challenge. With easy drag-and-drop controls and vibrant graphics, it offers a relaxing yet exciting experience for all ages.

title: Mickey Run Adventure Game
description:
Welcome to the great kingdom craft! prepare yourself brave mickey, get ready to run, jump, dash and rush through the kingdom.
In this craft game, you will be a runner who has to run and collect coins in an endless runner game mine. You need to be very careful as there will be many mouse in your way. You will need to use your craft Mickey and reflexes to avoid them and keep running. There will also be power-ups that you can collect to help you in the craft game.

title: Italian Brainrot Jigsaw
description: Italian Brainrot Jigsaw is a funny puzzle game with the most popular meme characters. You can select one of the fifteen images and then select one of the four modes (16, 36, 64 and 100 pieces). Select your favorite picture and complete the jigsaw in the shortest time possible! Have fun and enjoy!

title: Perfect Job Run
description: Run your way to the perfect job. In the Perfect Job Run, you'll run the platform of the workplace. Facing various challenges, selecting the right career path and becoming a winner in the workplace. There will be different career tests along the way. Quickly select tools to accomplish tasks.

title: Headless Joe
description: While playing, robot Joe literally lost his head. But it's not as hopeless as it seems. To get it back in place and screw it tightly, Joe needs to solve puzzles and collect all the bolts. But he can’t do this without your help!

title: CRAZY VAN
description:
Operate your car to defeat zombies! Defeating zombies will earn you coins, which you can use to strengthen your car.
If you kill a lot of zombies, the time limit will be added, allowing you to defeat more zombies.

title: Race It: Car Racing
description: Play Race It: Car Racing free online and jump into a high-speed browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Challenge rivals in intense 1v1 city races, swipe to drift, time your boosts, and outsmart opponents in a skill-based brain game of reflex and control. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for quick breaks and nonstop racing action.

title: Goal io
description: Play Goal.io free online and jump into a fast-paced browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Score wild goals, dodge rivals, and outplay opponents in quick matches that test reflexes like a competitive brain game. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, perfect for short breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for nonstop soccer action anytime.

title: Paint Roller
description: Control two tethered spheres in this unique painting challenge. Click to anchor one sphere in place while the other swings around it on an elastic tether, leaving a dynamic paint trail. Your objective? Strategically rotate your tethered pair to completely coat all target cylinders in each level.

title: Robby: Bomberman
description:
Dive into an exciting adventure with Robby, a brave hero who finds himself trapped in a labyrinth filled with ghosts and mysterious loot boxes. In this danger-filled world, to unlock the exit, Robby must defeat all the ghosts and destroy the crates, which may contain precious coins and useful bonuses.

But Robby is not alone in his fight! He has a loyal ally—a magical mushroom that can emerge from the loot boxes to assist him in battles against the ghosts.

title: Last to leave circle Obby
description:
Last to leave circle Obby - is a dynamic online game in the style of Roblox, where only the most dexterous and persistent can win! Exciting obby challenges, dangerous traps and intense battles with other players are waiting for you. Going outside the circle means you're out, and the circle is getting smaller and smaller!

Tense obby challenges that will test your reaction and agility.
Roblox-style game with unique multiplayer.
Ability to compete with friends and players from all over the world.

title: Tanks Merge: Tank War Blitz
description:
Embark on an armored adventure in Tanks Merge: Tanks to Attack on the Blitz! -
a strategy game where steel giants dominate the world.
Immerse yourself in a casual yet addictive tank simulation game
designed for those who love war machines and inventive tactics.
Have a blitz rumble and defeat all the bosses!
Your mission: control a fleet of tanks, each unique in design and
to defeat enemies and all bosses on the battlefield.

title: Nonogram Master
description:
Nonogram Master is an exciting puzzle game based on Japanese crosswords. Solve hidden pixel pictures using numbers as clues!

Choose a comfortable control method:
PC — Left-click to fill a square, right-click to mark with an "X".
Mobile — Tap control: select a mode and tap a cell.

Customize the game, train your logic, and enjoy the process! Are you ready to become a Nonogram Master?

title: Magic Piano Music
description: Ready to become a piano master? In Magic Piano Music, tap the magic tiles to follow the beats and play your favorite music. Follow the rhythm of the music and click with precision, don't miss any notes. The game will end after three misses. There's tons of music here like classic piano music, pop music and more! Every song will take you on an immersive arcade rhythm adventure.

title: Stack Battle.io
description:
It is a fun and casual puzzle. In the game, the game screen is fresh and simple, and the cute cartoon style is very eye-catching. The biggest highlight is the addition of tower defense battles to the brick-moving gameplay. The game level is very rich, and the gameplay is very simple. 
You can control the movement of the character by pressing and sliding on the screen.
What the player has to do is to control the character to collect the bricks on the map, stack the bricks and send them to your base. When there are enough bricks, your base will be upgraded and the area will be expanded and the number of tower defenses will be increased. 
When the enemy enters the range of your tower defense, you will be attacked. 
On the contrary, when you enter the range of the enemy tower defense, you will also be attacked. whichever side is attacked and dies first will fail the game, otherwise it will succeed.
Players who like brick-moving games come and download it.

title: 9 Blocks
description: Logical puzzle game with original gameplay. The goal is to fill all empty places in a chip merging with chips next to this one.

title: Stickman Troll Thief Puzzle
description: Thief Puzzle is a funny and addictive casual puzzle game. Here you should help a clever stickman with many funny ways to solve puzzles and steal target items. The rich and varied game scene contains many unexpected obstacles and traps, testing your intelligence and logical thinking. Each level of the game is a unique challenge. To make flexible movements of the character to overcome obstacles, avoid enemies, and successfully steal the target item.

title: Mage's Secret
description: Combine monsters and increase your power by thinking every action. You have to meet monsters, complete more than 100 tasks and learn the secret of the magician.

title: My kitties. Catworld
description:
Create your own world with unusual kittens!
At the beginning of the game three kittens are waiting for you, with black, white and ginger colors. 
Create unprecedented colors, mix colors and get new ones: blue, pink, neon-green and others. All this is in our game!
Replenish your collection and perform tasks!

title: 2048 Cube Merge
description: How far can your skills take you? Target, shoot and merge cubes while unlocking exciting upgrades and customizations. Enjoy captivating gameplay and stunning visuals with every move you make. The 2048 cube challenge begins now!

title: Robocarpoli
description:
In Brooms Town, you must solve four amazing adventures:

Problems with the pipes: 
In Brooms Town, a water pipe broke and the road is getting flooded. Help the Rescue Team to solve these situations completing 6 games: 
    • Connect the wires in Jin’s invention
    • Block the water leaks as soon as possible.
    • Solve Poli’s maze.
    • Work in a team with Micky.
    • Help Roy with the hoses.
    • Make Bruner as clean as a whistle.

title: Enchanted Mahjong Saga
description: Enchanted Mahjong Saga is a fast-paced twist on the classic tile-matching game, with unlimited levels to challenge your mind. Match tiles, beat the clock, and keep your streak alive as each level gets tougher and more exciting. Feeling stuck? Use helpful hints to get back on track and stay in the game.Whether youre playing for a quick break or settling in for a longer session, theres always a new puzzle waiting.

title: Kinder Garden
description: Run your own daycare in this hyper-casual arcade game! Care for babies by feeding, changing diapers, and keeping them happy. Unlock new rooms, toys, and upgrades to grow your nursery. Enjoy simple controls, fun gameplay, and happy rewards. Play now!

title: Hide & Seek Go And Find
description: Enjoy the classic game of Hide & Seek in a whole new way with 'Hide & Seek - Family Edition'! Play offline with up to five characters: mother, father, child, police, and thief, each with their unique role. Fathers seek their children, mothers search diligently, children hunt for hidden chocolates, police track down thieves, and thieves sneakily collect treasures.

title: Brainrot Merge Drop Puzzles
description: Drop and merge Italian Brainrot. Trallallero Trallala, Tum Tum Tum Saur, Boneca Ambalabu and more. Play funny memes. Drag and drop memes.

title: Stickman Doors and Island
description:
Open all the criminal's doors and escape from the desert island!
You will have to go through two interesting escape stories.
The first story is about how the criminal kidnapped the character Stick and locked him in the rooms.
The second story is about how the character Stick ended up on an island in the ocean.
Go through all the stories, fight for your life! Break open doors, use various objects. Guess all the puzzles and versions of fate.

title: Bolts
description:
Test your logic and strategy in this unique puzzle game. Solve intricate challenges by unscrewing bolts in the right order—every move counts.

Features:
Unique Levels – Each puzzle offers a fresh challenge.

Strategic Gameplay – The sequence of moves is key.

Engaging Puzzles – Designed to push your problem-solving skills.

Every detail matters. Can you master the mechanics?

title: Zombies: Battle for Survival
description: Survive an endless onslaught of zombies! Each wave gets harder, ammo is running low, and hope is fading. Unlock new areas, buy weapons, upgrade gear, and build barricades to slow the undead. Can you endure the nightmare and set a new record?

title: Stick Fight The Chaos
description: Hello young warriors! In Stick Fight The Chaos, the fierce battles between stickmen continue with even more action! Catch the weapons falling from the sky, challenge your opponent and become the champion of the battlefield! Keep your balance, focus on your enemy and keep fighting! Each level brings new surprises. Play alone or with a friend and defeat your opponents!

title: Pictures Riddle
description:
Guess 1 word based on shown 4 pictures
Discover what word can be related to pictures
Game has 2 modes: “Pictures” & “Riddles”
 
Features:
-     Simple & addictive gameplay
-     Challenging riddles
-     Hundreds of fun levels
-     …

title: Uncle Bullet 007
description:
Play as Uncle Bullet, a retired spy who’s back in the game to take down rival agents and save the day. Armed with an arsenal of bouncy bullets, you’ll use your wits and quick reflexes to outmaneuver foes and rescue hostages.

Shoot your bullets at walls, ceilings, and floors to make them bounce, ricochet, and curve around corners to hit your targets.

title: Find It Out Colorful Book
description: Begin a challenging yet relaxing casual game in Find It Out Colorful Book. It brings you into a colorful world. You will begin an adventure to find hidden objects. Choose your favorite mode like beach, city, zoo, etc. Each page is filled with color and mysterious numbers waiting to be discovered and unlocked.

title: LOL Funny Dance
description: LOL Funny Dance is a hilarious 2D game where you can distort the faces of politicians and celebrities to create the funniest expressions! Drag and move different points on the image to stretch, twist, and transform their looks into ridiculous and exaggerated versions. Watch them dance and react as you manipulate their faces in real time. Play the LOL Funny Dance game now.

title: Shoot And Drive
description:
Radiation is spreading all over the world. People are going crazy, a tough battle for life continues.
After falling into the trap of bandits along with your crewmates, you’ll have to fight to the end. And your best ‘friends’ — a rusty gun and a car that’s about to stall — will come to your aid.

title: Letters Match
description: Letters Match combines the best of the games you love. This is a mixture of matching games, word search and clearing the playing field. We took all these ingredients and spiced it up with exciting gameplay. If you like to stretch your brain with puzzles, then Letters Match is what you need!

title: Looper
description:
Looper is a joyous and melodious music game that tests your sense of rhythm and timing. Get ready to start tapping your way through a colorful universe of beats and melodies! With hundreds of unique levels, Looper is the perfect game to soothe your puzzling needs.

As you progress, the constellations become more complex, and the beats more satisfying. But be warned, mistiming a tap could lead to an epic crash and burn - so make sure to bring your A-game!

title: Mega Ramp Car
description:
Mega Ramp Car is a game with maximum speed and huge jumps! Are you ready to make the biggest leap in history?

Mega Ramp Car Features
- Realistic physics and sound effects.
- Real car collection
- This game allows you to perform amazing stunts on different jumps.
- Complete multiple levels and game modes for non-stop fun!
- You have to complete many challenging missions, which makes the game even more exciting.

Buy new cars to win new races.

title: Clicker Hero
description: Click on the screen to defeat the monsters and earn gold in Clicker Hero. Spend your gold to buy and upgrade heroes that deal damage automatically. Then advance to fight tougher monsters that drop more gold. This game keeps going, even when you're offline, so come back later to earn and spend even more!

title: Tap Block Puzzle: Smash Game
description:
Tap Block Puzzle: Smash Game is a satisfying and addictive puzzle game where you tap on two or more matching blocks to smash them!
? Clear the board, create massive combos, and reach high scores in this colorful, fun-packed block smashing experience.
Perfect for casual players and puzzle lovers alike!

title: Hexon Rush
description:
Hexon Rush is a time limited puzzle game with a little bit of sci-fi look.

Main goal in the Hexon Rush is connecting all the lines inside the hexagonal tiles before time runs out.  There are 600 levels with increasing size, difficulty and complexity.

Don't worry, you will have two types of helpers to solve these puzzles. Be careful when you spend them because they are hard to obtain.

title: Ships 3D IO
description: Ships 3D is an IO game, multiplayer sailing ship simulator. The game is played in 'first person' where you control the sailor and move around the ship; interacting with the helm, sails and cannons. Sink enemy ships and shoot other players to score points.

title: Motor Tour
description: In Motor tour, the ultimate racing game, you'll experience an unforgettable adrenaline-pumping adventure with multiple modes to choose from. Take on fierce competitors, embark on an endless journey, or take things up a notch by daringly weaving through traffic with heart-stopping near misses. Don't wait any longer, start playing now and immerse yourself in this epic experience that is sure to leave you on the edge of your seat!

title: Candy Chain Master
description: Welcome to Candy Chain Master! The board has blue tiles with candies on them. Start by selecting a candy and move across nearby tiles with the same candy to make a chain of three or more. Each tile must turn golden by matching at least one candy on it. Think carefully and move fast to turn all tiles golden before time runs out.

title: FNF 2 Player
description:
FNF 2 Player allows two players to play at the same time. Players can compete with each other by choosing the characters they want. The difficulty level can be determined by the music, thus appealing to all types of players.

Game Modes: 

- Story Mode: You fight with new characters weekly.
- Freeplay Mode: You can play by choosing the song you want.
- 2 Player Mode: It's time to duel with your friend.

title: Idle Dice 3D: Incremental Game
description:
In this game, you roll dice and accumulate coins. Upgrade dice to generate more coins, even when you are not actively playing (Offline earnings).

Idle Dice 3D stands out with its variety of dice: from classic six-sided to dice with 2, 4, 8, 10, 12, and 20 sides. Aim for combinations like pairs, triples, straights, and more to increase profit.

The Prestige system allows you to reset your progress to boost future earnings, adding a strategic element to the game. The game also has achievements.

title: Sort Puzzle - Nuts and Bolts
description: Play Sort Puzzle - Nuts and Bolts, a free and addictive sorting game! Train your brain by stacking nuts of the same color. Simple yet challenging, it's the perfect casual game to relax and sharpen your logic skills. Play now and start sorting!

title: Cool SuperCars Stunts PvP
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning supercar through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Kitkat Puzzle
description:
Enter the world of Kitkat Puzzle, a captivating and intricate pin puzzle game where your strategic thinking and creativity are put to the test.

The mission is straightforward - unlock kitkat holes to make these chocolate bars fall in the correct sequence. Sounds simple, yet with unlimited levels of varying complexity, it promises an intriguing brain-teasing journey.

title: My Fire Station World
description: Have you ever wondered how the firefighter rescues and helps others in emergencies? How do they deal with dangerous fires? This role-play takes you to explore the world of firefighters and learn about their daily work. Our game has 6 scenarios about the life and work of firefighters for you to choose from. You can drag and drop to place the characters as you like, place props, and change the firefighting costumes.

title: 2048 Run Gorgeous Balls
description: 2048 Run: Gorgeous Balls is a fun arcade game that invites you to chase high scores in a delightful environment! In this creative 2048-style game, you’ll control a colorful array of balls as they race along a dynamic track.

title: Diamond mosaic
description: Ready to create your own masterpiece from a scattering of diamonds on your screen? Come to our mosaic!  Fill images with diamond scatter!

title: HOTGEAR
description:
Join HOTGEAR, a brand-new racing game where the thrill of the chase is just beginning. The pursuit is on, and it's time to put your skills to the test! The game offers a wide range of customization options, allowing you to create the car of your dreams and make every chase even more thrilling.
So, what are you waiting for, racer? The pursuit has begun, and you're wanted! Time to get in the driver's seat, customize your car, and take on the streets!

title: Bubble Shooter Crystal Hunt
description: Bubble Shooter Crystal Hunt is an exciting endless bubble-shooting puzzle game where players must collect specific target bubbles along with rare magical crystals that appear among the bubbles. Aim carefully and match three or more bubbles of the same color to clear space while the bubble wall slowly moves toward the border line, increasing tension with every shot. Crystals are hidden within bubble clusters and must also be collected to progress and boost scores.

title: The Flowers: Merge and Sell Bouquets
description: Combine flowers in the relaxing atmosphere of a summer garden and earn coins! Sell your bouquets to customers and clear your garden of unwanted flowers with your pruning shears! Earn more coins than other players to take a place on the leaderboard!

title: People Playground: Ragdoll Battle
description:
Welcome to People Playground: Ragdoll Battle!
Carefully control your character to strike the right spots on your opponent’s body. Attack strategically to destroy and crush your enemies. Earn gold coins to unlock new characters and upgrade your skills.
Have fun and dominate the arena!

title: Blade Forge 3D
description: Step into the fiery forge of Blade Forge 3D, the ultimate 3D simulation casual game. You become the legendary blacksmith. Craft epic weapons from scratch. After matching opponents, choose your own mold and craft your own sword. Temper the sword by forging the blade between the flames. Once completed, the sword will be used to test itself against your opponent. Serious polishing to boost your damage value.

title: ASMR Water vs Fire
description:
Water vs Fire, upgrade your water power and damp down the fire!
And Have fun!

Upgrade your Water Power and your Amount of Canister.


- Easy intuitive controls
- Release to shoot

title: Obby Pinata Party
description: Help the Obby guy to fight those pinatas and Explore the world. Choose from wide variety of weapons, collect coins and upgrade them. Make the pinatas give you every penny they have!

title: Graduation Makeup Trends
description: Discover the latest makeup trends with our Graduation Makeup Trends game! From bold and fierce to soft and elegant, this game offers a variety of makeup options to suit your style. We bring 3 BFFs, each with a unique style, many makeup options, stunning dresses, and accessories for your inspiration. Mixed with floral printed dresses, golden jewelry, and holographic accessories, in the Graduation Makeup Trends game, you will find everything you need to help these girls make a statement.

title: Luxury Highway Cars
description: Skid the wheels of 6 stunning luxury cars with insane speed limits and drive them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself in Luxury Highway Cars!

title: Hole Digger
description: Grab your shovel and start your journey deep into the earth. Mine valuable resources, upgrade your tools, level up your skills, and unlock new opportunities for even faster digging. The deeper you dig, the richer the treasures. Can you reach the very bottom?

title: My Cake Shop: Bake & Serve
description: Run your own sweet bakery in My Cake Shop! Bake and stack colorful donuts, clean messy floors, and serve hungry customers. Expand across the world by unlocking new bakery locations and upgrading machines. Manage crowds, grow your patisserie empire, and become the ultimate idle arcade tycoon!

title: Fruit Jam Master
description: Enter the juiciest and most addictive puzzle adventure ever. Enjoy a fun logic puzzle game in Fruit Jam Master. You need to help all the animals leave the grassland to win. Pay attention to the color of the food. Animals can only pass through when the food matches their own color.

title: Bark & Blast
description: Crash-land on a post-apocalyptic planet in Bark & Blast! Help a brave alien dog survive and escape in this thrilling 2D platformer action RPG. Test your aim, strategy, and courage in an epic adventure. Play now and conquer the challenges!

title: Scary Baby Yellow Game
description:
You have a new babysitting job, and things are becoming odd. Feed him, give him a bedtime tale, and avoid falling into his nightmares about him. How long can you maintain control?

Try to care for a weird infant in a lonely and unusual residence. Look for the baby in each area and follow the directions to reach your objective and finish the level.

title: Dead Zone Mech Ops
description:
Dead Zone: Mech Ops thrusts players into the heart of a scorched Earth ravaged by endless war, where autonomous factions and rogue AI compete for control over the planet’s last remaining strongholds. You are a combat pilot in the elite “Mech Ops” unit — the final line of defense in a world on the brink of total collapse.
Players will command next-gen combat exosuits equipped with modular weapon systems, advanced targeting tech, and adaptive armor that reacts to battlefield conditions.

description:
"Block Puzzle" is a fun and classic block game!
And our Block Puzzle is not just that. It is more Simple and addictive! Once you start, you will not stop playing. Just have a try, you will love it!

For fans of fast-paced, skill-based games, this is a must-play because of the thrilling combination of racing, platforming, and character advancement. In this adrenaline-pumping game, you'll have to crank your engines, level up your character, and complete parkour tasks.

title: Super Kid Adventure
description: Hi there! It sounds like you're interested in playing Super Kid Adventure, an online game similar to Super Mario. To play, you'll need to jump on platforms, avoid obstacles and spikes, and defeat enemies. Don't forget to collect stars along the way! The game has 25 levels for you to explore, so there's plenty of adventure to be had.

title: Formula Racers
description: Formula Racers is the ultimate HTML5 browser top-down arcade racing game - no download required! Race on any device across 10 thrilling tracks, tackle dynamic lap tracking and real-time placement, and earn coins to unlock and upgrade cars (engine, gearbox, steering, brakes). This online racing game features HD graphics, responsive design, immersive SFX & music - perfect for mobile & desktop gamers seeking fast-paced, addictive arcade action!

title: Block Dropping Merge
description:
Block Dropping Merge is a special but classic number merge puzzle. It's easy to play but hard to master.
Show us how good you are among other puzzlers!

1024 2048 4096 8192 16384... Drop them numbers and merge to get bigger numbers and show how smart you are!

Play and share your best score now!
