description: A game in the sorting genre, but in the form of sorting frogs, great graphics, very many levels, and a large variety of frogs. Several variations of levels. Pass levels, get achievements, unlock new kinds of frogs!

title: DTA 2: Maniac
description: DTA 2: Maniac. Create chaos like GTA. Use a vast arsenal of weapons, steal bulldozers, buses, police cars, tanks and much more - destruction is all around!

title: Wacky Strike
description:
This time you will choose who are you actually. Well, no. Who is the strongest! Girls, or boys! So, just build a lot of towers, and buy your cool enemy! Fight like the real hero and you will cope with it, just try it!

Are you a good fighter? Then this game is for you! Just pick a side, setup your troops, and fight against your mortal enemy, do you think that it is so easy?! Then march from your castle to the enemy castle claiming ground in between.

title: Mobile Phone Case Design & DIY
description: Welcome to Mobile Phone Case Design & DIY, the ultimate playground for those who love to personalize, design, and express their unique style!

title: Mega Ramps Ultimate Car Races
description: Mega Ramp Car Stunt Game 2024: Race Car Stunts 3D Enjoy our new mega car driving games with beautiful environments and impossible car games. Indulge in the exciting gameplay of mega ramp car by performing impossible stunts with new car games 2024. Master your driving skills as a mature driver in 3D landscapes of Mega Ramps Ultimate Car Races.

title: Relaxing cubes and campfire
description: A relaxing and peaceful game with delightful campfire sounds! You can easily learn how to play and win - just place blocks to create and remove vertical and horizontal lines. The game is suitable for all ages.

title: Labubu Jetpack Rush
description: Fly high in Jetpack Jump with Labubu to survive the escape from the lab! Tap to use the jetpack and release to run . Upgrade your jetpack, your running speed and other upgrades to be able to travel further than before and beat your high score. The further you travel the more money you get!

title: Super Sprunki Clicker
description: Enjoy the Sprunki World in this clicker idle game. Immerse yourself in the beats and music simulation, create the band, and use the rewards to buy new upgrades and features. Break the screen touching the sprunkis, hire automatic clickers, social media features, instruments, and everything to become the Sprunki King.

title: Jewelry Idle
description: What is the best jewelry? Of course, those made with your own hands! Create the best jewelry store! Design stunning pieces, attract discerning customers, and watch your business thrive in this sparkling venture!

title: Europe at War
description:
Europe stands on the brink of the greatest conflict in history. It's 1936 - choose your nation and decide the fate of the continent.
Europe at War is a turn-based strategy with a detailed map of Europe divided into 369 regions. Manage your economy, build factories and barracks, research technologies, forge alliances or declare wars.
Three paths to victory: conquer all regions by force, unite Europe through diplomatic alliances, or build an industrial empire of 12 factories.

title: Noob Ragdoll: Crazy Punch
description:
In "Noob Ragdoll: Crazy Punch", you'll see the world from a unique perspective - through the eyes of the glove itself! 

What Awaits You:
-First-person camera - Feel like you're delivering the punch yourself!
-Minecraft-style characters and vibrant action-packed scenes
-Epic punches and spectacular body launches on every level
-Multiple glove skins - choose yours and strike with style!

Test your accuracy and style in "Noob Ragdoll: Crazy Punch" - ragdoll physics has never been this dynamic!

title: Number Tubes
description: Relax and train your brain with Number Tubes — the addictive number sorting and merging game! Tap to move balls, merge the same numbers into bigger ones, and keep going to beat your best score. No time limits, no pressure — just pure fun. Perfect for fans of merge games, number games, and classic sort puzzles.

title: Mine 2D Survival Herobrine
description:
"Mine 2D: Survival Herobrine" - a continuation of adventures, but no longer in prison, but in a world where you will have to survive together with noob!
You have a whole open world in front of you, where you can do anything you want: complete challenging tasks, mine and improve resources, and build grandiose constructions from blocks!  
Beware of Monsters: You will have to fight off monsters that want you dead. 
Herobrine: A frightening type who will try to scare you in every possible way!

title: Fortune's Deck Solitaire
description:
Welcome to Fortune's Deck Solitaire, where ancient Tarot magic meets the timeless thrill of Tripeaks!

Three enchanted towers of fate await your touch - draw from the mystical deck and begin your journey through the arcana.

Inspired by the classic Tripeaks Solitaire, this magical twist invites you to clear the cards, trust your intuition, and let the deck reveal your fortune.

Will you find insight, mystery… or unexpected luck?

title: Happy Egg Catch
description:
Happy Egg Catch is a fun and colorful arcade skill game where timing and precision are the key to victory!

Eggs are hanging from the top and swinging back and forth. Your goal is simple: tap at the perfect moment to release the egg and land it safely inside the basket below. But be careful, the basket moves to different positions every round, so you must aim your throw carefully!

Test your reflexes, master the swing timing, and see how many eggs you can catch in a row!

title: Cars Derby Arena
description: Welcome to the world of Car Derby Arena! In this exciting game you can enjoy the unique experience of changing the color of cars, improving their performance, and manipulating gravity and weather conditions. Your goal is to become an invincible master of destruction, pump up your car and crush everything in your path. Embark on exciting missions, compete with other players and prove your skills in this epic Car Derby Arena game!

title: Battle Simulator - Sandbox
description:
You can play against the provided levels or create your own battle.

Victory depends only on the best strategy! With the most accurate placement of your army, you will achieve the best results!

title: Countryside Truck Drive
description: Embark on a picturesque journey in Countryside Truck Driving, where you'll navigate your transport truck through a charming countryside town, with stunning ice-capped mountain ranges as your backdrop; collect coins, dodge roadblocks, and test your skills to achieve the highest score.

title: Children Happy Farm DuDu
description: Hey there, little farmers in the making! Welcome to "Children Happy Farm DuDu"! This is an amazing casual simulator designed just for your kids. In this fun-filled farm world, you'll be the boss of your farm. The farm is full of cute animals like fluffy sheep, clucking chickens, and friendly cows. Your job is to take good care of them. Feed the animals, clean their shelters, and make sure they are happy.

title: Golf Orbit
description:
One shot golf simulator is the battle of golf rivals to become the golf king worldwide. Become part of this idle golf orbit rocket league in which balls go high to Mars. Smash the ball to mars and become the golf champions.

Oneshot Golf Orbit is golf offline game which has many golf rocket leagues and one shot golf battles. Be part Mars golf games to become champions of golfing over it.

title: Gun Racing
description: Here you cannot just race with other cars, but destroy them with the help of numerous weapons. Improve your riding skills and take first places in tournaments!

title: Help The Duck
description:
Helping Little Duck
In this Skill Game help a charming little duckling to fall into the tub with water. Throw the water in the correct places so that the duckling falls directly into the tub. - Play Helping Little Duck Free and Enjoy!

title: Ragdoll Bounce
description: Jump into a fun 2D challenge where you control a ragdoll launched by a bigger ragdoll. Click to bounce on platforms and keep climbing. But be careful—missing a platform means a big fall!

title: Pops Quest
description: In this story-based platformer, you'll step into the shoes of a heroic protagonist driven by an undying love for their child. Experience the perfect fusion of action and platforming as Pop's Quest takes you on a high-octane adventure. With its fast-paced gameplay levels designed, you'll be engrossed in a world that demands agility, strategy, and quick reflexes. As you progress, you'll be emotionally invested and driven to save your child from danger.

title: Mermaidcore Aesthetics
description: In Mermaidcore Aesthetics, you'll embark on a thrilling undersea adventure alongside three fabulous fashionistas. Each mermaid has a unique and stunning wardrobe that will make your inner fashionista do a happy dance! With a wide selection of clothing options and accessories available at your disposal, you'll have endless possibilities to create your fashionable mermaid looks. Have a blast!

title: Dungeon Master – Cult & Craft
description: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a mysterious dungeon, where you are its keeper and master! Turn simple stickmen into devoted followers capable of mining ore and creating value for your dark empire. Develop the Cult, manage resources and expand the boundaries of your underground Universe!

title: Just Dice - Random Tower Defence
description: ? Welcome to "Just Dice: Random Tower Defense"! Get ready to roll the dice and defend your territory against hordes of relentless monsters in this exciting tower defense game. With a unique merging mechanic and vibrant visuals, you'll be hooked from the very first roll!

title: Shape-Shifting
description: Choose different vehicles to adapt to various terrains, allowing yourself to navigate through the terrain faster and become the first in the race.

title: Serious Bro
description: Defend your base against adorable alien invaders using an M16 Carbine Rifle and frag grenades. Experience a beautiful low poly 3D environment with cute enemies and simple controls for both desktop and mobile.

title: Fruit Mahjong 3D
description: Fruit Mahjong 3D is a relaxing puzzle game where you match pairs of fruit-themed tiles in 3D space. Rotate the view, find free tiles, and clear the board by matching identical pieces. Each level is handcrafted and fully solvable, offering a mix of easy and challenging layouts. The game starts with a short tutorial and gradually increases in difficulty. Use shuffle and hint buttons if you get stuck. Enjoy colorful graphics, smooth animations, and intuitive controls on both mobile and desktop.

title: Obby - Escape Barry's jail parkour
description: An incredible escape from the New Barry Prison awaits you! Cool locations, parkour and obby. Show your agility to avoid getting caught by Barry.

title: Komaru cat
description:
Take care of Komaru the cat! Pet her, feed her, bathe her, and tuck her in for sleep!
Dress her up in stylish looks! Hats, glasses, collars, new fur colors, and more! Experiment and create your own unique cat!
Play the merge mini-game, compete on the leaderboard, and earn coins!
Watch the best video memes with funny moments from her life!
Complete the daily challenges and come back tomorrow, Komaru will miss you!
Try to unlock all achievements! Come and have fun!

title: Idle Inventor
description:
Grow your industrial powerhouse: become a heavy machine titan of industry!

Manufacture cars, trucks, planes, military vehicles, and high-tech instruments for space exploration!

Watch your factory grow from a single production line to a world-famous industrial powerhouse. And because you’re automating, your factory keeps working while you’re away - check in the morning,  it’s amazing to see how much money you made while sleeping

Try it now, and see how the idle tycoon life suits you!

title: Garden Guardians
description:
A fun and strategic tower defense game that’s easy to pick up!
Tap directional arrows to launch seeds into flowerpots—each seed blossoms into a powerful flower ready to blast incoming zombies. Plan your moves, hold the line, and protect your garden from the undead horde!

title: Obby Tower Parkour Climb
description:
Dive into the parkour adventure with Obby in the Hell Tower game theme. Climb colored platforms and get to the finished platform for a great reward.
The game contains three hell tower maps easy, medium, and hard. Play these maps in two different modes normal mode and challenge mode. Try to do your best timing in challenge mode in either single-player or 2 player game mode. You can also compete against your friend in normal mode in the 2-player game mode option.

title: Bolts and Nuts - Sorting
description: Bolts and Nuts - Sorting is a captivating casual game where each level challenges your logic and attentiveness! Unscrew bolts, collect nuts, and solve puzzles to progress. Simple controls and intuitive gameplay make the game accessible to everyone, while gradually increasing difficulty keeps it exciting.

title: Monster Slayers
description: Monster Slayers is a single‑player mobile roguelike RPG where you must survive endless waves of monsters all by yourself. Every run is a new chance to build the perfect hero, outplay growing hordes, and prove that one warrior can stand against an entire army.

title: Bunnyhop and Surf Maps
description: Game that brings bunnyhop and surf from "Counter Strike" straight to your browser! The game features a variety of parkour maps, many knife skins, unique bunnyhop mechanics, the ability to accelerate with a knife, and the opportunity to compete with other players to see who can reach the finish line first.

title: Cards 2048
description: Are you looking for a fresh twist on a familiar game? Cards 2048 is the perfect blend of classic solitaire and the popular 2048 puzzle game! This unique combination creates an engaging brain teaser that's highly addictive. As you merge cards with matching numbers, the challenge intensifies, offering a true test of your skill and strategy. Sharpen your logic and enjoy hours of fun with Cards 2048, the ultimate card merging game for puzzle enthusiasts!

title: Ride Shooter
description: What if the whole world is filled with zombies? Of course get in a car, equip it with weapons and armor, and then break through to the others! What's next? Machine gun, laser and attack helicopter!

title: Twinkle Shooter
description: Shoot at stones of the same color to drop them. They can be cleared when three or more of the same color are matched. If a stone enters the heart, the slot spins for a fever chance! The game is over if the stones reach the bottom.

title: Wild West Match
description: Embark on a captivating Wild West adventure with Bonnie! Explore iconic landscapes, face challenges, and uncover secrets in this thrilling journey. The frontier spirit awaits – join Bonnie on the quest for an unforgettable adventure!

title: Goodeluxe
description: Goo Deluxe is a Collapse game with a sticky and satisfying aesthetic. It's a simple and relaxing game. Unlike other Goobox games, Goo Deluxe is not limited by time, allowing you all the time to think. Isn't that true luxury?

title: Cube Combo
description: CubeCombo is a casual puzzle game. In this game, players need to use their wits by moving blocks with numbers, and merge the same blocks together until only one block is left, to complete the challenge. When only one number block is left in the panel or the target number block is synthesized, the current level is passed and a new level is opened.

title: Badlands Hero
description:
Step into a treacherous world teeming with enemies and peril. Guide your hero across the battlefield — they’ll fire automatically when foes show up!

? Conquer intense levels
? Gain XP to unlock unique heroes
? Gather gold to enhance your gear
? Unleash powerful weapon types
? Face off against epic bosses and climb the ranks

Easy to play, hard to master. Do you have what it takes to rule the Badlands?

title: GT Cars Mega Ramps
description: Exotic cars, mega ramps, colorful giant bosses and face to face races all come together in this game. GT Cars Mega Ramps invites you to a fantastic driving experience with its completely unique game-play. Fly over mega ramps with your customized exotic car, destroy giant bosses or try to finish the stages first in face to face races!

title: Dragon Egg
description: Players can unlock higher-level Divine Dragon eggs by moving three or more of them. Supports multi-level recursive synthesis of 5-color dragon eggs. Eventually, unlocking high-level dragon eggs can unlock the birth of new dragons, accompanied by splendid animations, filling the sense of achievement to the fullest.

title: Family Tree Puzzle
description:
Get ready to dig into the family history and piece together the puzzle! In Family Tree Puzzle, you’ll be presented with a set of clues that will challenge your problem-solving skills and test your ability to think critically.

Using the given information, assemble the family tree by connecting the dots between relatives and ancestors.

title: Pixel Mini Golf
description:
Mini Golf is a complete game, with 400 different levels, and an addictive system. Have fun exploring the game’s green hills and plains while listening to the birds and enjoying its beautiful views, collect as many coins as possible and try to hit all the holes to achieve the highest score.

Among the game mechanics are levels with: Portals, Boxing Gloves, Cannons, Burners, Impulses, Mill, Sand, Mole Holes, Spikes and Movement Blocks that will help or hinder your game!

title: Freecell Solitaire
description:
Put your mind to the test with FreeCell, one of the most beloved solitaire card games of all time!

Move cards between columns, use the free cells cleverly, and organize suits in ascending order to win.

Elegant graphics, smooth animations, and intuitive controls make every game a relaxing and satisfying experience.

Whether you're a solitaire veteran or a curious beginner, FreeCell will win you over with its perfect mix of simplicity and strategy.

title: Ultimate Sports Car Drift
description: Dive into the world of Ultimate Sports Car Drift and feel the rush of adrenaline as you take on the ultimate drifting challenges. Whether you're a seasoned pro or a newcomer to the world of drift racing, this game offers something for everyone. Buckle up, hit the gas, and let the drifting madness begin!

title: BFF Lovely Kawaii Outfits
description: Welcome to BFF Lovely Kawaii Outfits game. Princesses Elsa, Anna, Moana, and Jasmine are more fascinated about Kawaii Outfits. They are very eager to browse the new collection of Kawaii outfits. Start helping with each princess for their outfits and matching costumes by browsing their wardrobe. Play these cute girl games and have fun!

title: Tiny Cars
description: Tiny Cars is a colorful arcade traffic management game where players must avoid collisions. With a top-down view and engaging gameplay, this game features 50 base stages set in various locations like crossroads, squares, and highways. After completing the initial 50 levels, players will encounter the same environments with increased difficulty, offering a challenging and addictive experience for traffic control enthusiasts. Enjoy managing the traffic and becoming a master of Tiny Cars, the ultimate arcade traffic management game!

title: Arrow Escape: Puzzle
description:
“Arrow Escape: Puzzle” is a logic puzzle where arrows block each other, and your goal is to untangle routes and clear the level by choosing the correct move order.

- Short levels you can play in a minute.  
- Focus on logic and move order, not speed.  
- Simple controls: one tap — one move.

title: The Office Escape
description: The Office Escape is an exciting adventure where every step towards freedom becomes a test for the Regime and the thinking factor!

title: Vehicle Fun Race
description: Vehicle Fun Race—an exhilarating arcade game with 3D stickman characters. Collect motorcycles, cars, boats, and helicopters to reach the finish line. No need to grab vehicles; your character can handle all terrains. Dive into water? No problem—control their swim. Special helicopters await on final platforms. Ready to race? Let’s roll!

title: Jewels Blitz Legends
description: Embark on a dazzling adventure in Jewels Blitz Legends, the epic sequel to the beloved Match 3 hit! Travel through ancient Inca temples, uncover mystical secrets, and match colorful gems to unlock treasures. Explore Machu Picchu, complete hundreds of challenging levels, and take on exciting daily missions and weekly events. Collect gold, magical artifacts, and experience stunning visuals in this addictive journey through the heart of ancient legend!

title: Bow And Arrow
description:
? Bow and Arrow – Master Your Archery Skills! ?

Step into the world of precision shooting in Bow and Arrow! Test your skills, aim with accuracy, and hit your targets in a variety of exciting levels. Whether you're shooting at moving targets, battling enemies, or competing in archery challenges, this game will put your skills to the test!

title: Zombie Outbreak Survive
description: With this entertaining game you will have to run throughout the city, run and shoot because the zombies are fast and dangerous, they will not stop chasing you to devour you.The zombie apocalypse has arrived and the terror of surviving has arrived with this new game. Zombie Outbreak Survive is a 3D game with impressive and realistic graphics that will make your hair stand on end and you will feel the true fear of being devoured.

title: Human Evolution Run
description: Start with a skeleton, choose your evolution route.

title: Fun Sorting Through The Shelves
description: Unwind with this charming match-3 puzzle game! Spot matching items, place them neatly on shelves, and merge triplets to free up space. Collect treasures, decorate, and design your own cozy virtual nook in a relaxing experience for all ages.

title: World Cup 2026 Soccer Game
description:
Choose your national team and enter the excitement of the World Cup! 
Play as your favorite heroes like Cristiano Ronald, Lionel Messi or Kylian Mbappe and jump into fast-paced 1v1 soccer battles to claim the cup! 
Defend your goal, watch for the perfect opening, and strike to score!
Challenge the CPU or compete against friends, sharpen your skills, and climb your way to the top. Victory is just a goal away!

title: Smoke Trail
description:
Drift and earn in this fast-paced 2D endless drifting game!
Master the art of controlled slides across an ever-changing track. Rack up cash by chaining stylish drifts and maintaining momentum—then use your earnings to unlock a growing collection of iconic drift cars, each with its own unique stats and feel. But it’s not just about the money—complete challenges to test your skill, and unlock a special car.

Easy to pick up, hard to master—how far can you go before you crash?

title: Seafaring Memory Challenge
description: Set sail into the captivating depths of the ocean with Seafaring Memory Challenge! Match pairs of sea-themed icons in an endless array of levels. Test your memory skills as you uncover treasures like colorful fish, delicate sea shells, and sunken treasures. With no level limit, the adventure never ends, providing hours of entertainment. Stay sharp and immerse yourself in the mesmerizing world beneath the waves!

title: Super Dog Hero Dash
description: Super Dog Hero Dash is an interesting 3D running game with endless adventure and fun! You’ll become a brave dog hero running through a colorful city in this cartoonish world. Begin exciting challenges across various platforms!

title: SUIKA WATERMELON DROP
description: Engage, merge, and challenge yourself in this thrilling fruit-matching journey! Drop and collide identical fruits to evolve them, preventing them from falling out of the box. But here's the exciting twist: every time matching fruits collide, they transform into a completely new one. Can you keep merging your way up to the ultimate prize, the grand watermelon? The challenge awaits!

title: Savage Defenders
description: A tower defense strategy action game where you become the last hope of a tribe living at the foot of an ancient volcano. When an asteroid with an alien threat falls to the planet, you must combine magic, tactics and the strength of warriors to stop the invader who is devouring all life.

title: GT Drift Most Wanted
description:
Drift your way around each level and hit all the snow piles while avoiding barriers. With responsive controls and a focus on timing and precision, players must master their drifting skills to clear each stage and become the ultimate Drift Master.
In this game, players can purchase different cars, each offering a unique driving experience. There’s no customization—just pick your favorite car and hit the track!

title: Ultimate Tower Defense
description: Ultimate Tower Defense is an exciting strategy game that perfectly blends tower defense, battle, and fast-paced action into one addictive experience. In the game, you must carefully protect defense towers and deploy powerful heroes to stop endless waves of enemies. Each tower has unique attack abilities. Select your preferred mode to begin the challenge.

title: Block Sniper
description:
Pixelated sniper action game where you have to complete various missions in a blocky world. 
Game where you are a sniper who performs various missions in a block-based world.

title: Ice Cream Inc.
description:
Ice Cream Simulator is a satisfying casual game where you step into the shoes of a master ice cream artist. Your goal is to run the most popular shop in town by creating the ice cream of your dreams!

From classic Vanilla and Dark Chocolate to fruity Mango and Juicy Strawberry, you have all the ingredients needed to create the perfect frozen treat. Whether your customers want a soft-serve cone, ice cream rolls, frozen yogurt, or traditional Gelato, it’s up to you to serve them with a smile.

title: Block Puzzle - Frozen Jewel
description: An addictive block puzzle game that helps train your eyes and brain. It is a combination between the Tetris and Jewels game styles.

title: World Z Defense - Zombie Defense
description: Zombies have taken over the world! Unlock bases and deploy soldiers with unique weapons, each with stats like damage, fire rate, and reload speed. Soldiers must reload at the base before defending. Place them wisely to stop zombies within range. Defeat waves to earn coins, upgrade bases, and survive stronger hordes. Strategically choose soldiers to clear waves and save cities across the globe.

title: Funny Walk Fail Run
description: Funny Walk Fail Run is a fun-filled arcade action game with funny and magical gameplay! You will control a villain in the game to do challenges. But don't expect him to walk steadily, because he always falls and bumps in all sorts of funny positions! Your job is to help him navigate each step of the shaky road.

title: Sprunki Link
description:
Sprunki Link – the wildest Sprunki-fueled tile puzzle!
Find and connect matching tiles featuring your favorite chaotic Sprunki characters.
Test your focus and logic across 15 levels of pure unhinged madness.
Can you collect all 45 stars, or will the Sprunki win?
It’s fast, it’s silly, it’s dangerously addictive – Sprunki-style!

title: Merge Galaxy
description:
The famous merge game is arrived!
You can shoot the planets like balls to throw, and when the same planets touch each other, it becomes bigger planet!
Cute planets want to be bigger, so keep merge the planets until you make the sun!

title: Missile Launch Master
description: Experience the thrill of Boom Missile 3D, a 3D simulation game that will test your missile skills. You will play as a missile pilot who must dodge hot air balloons and helicopters in the sky. You will also have to fly the missile over an island and hit the target before the time runs out. Boom Missile 3D is a game that combines stunning 3D graphics and smooth controls. You will feel like you are in the cockpit of a real missile. Can you complete all the missions and destroy the enemy’s base?

title: Shop Sorting Xmas
description: Love a well-organized, neatly arranged space? Then Shop Sorting Xmas is the perfect game for you! Step into a delightful Christmas-themed puzzle game where you’ll sort and arrange festive items in a magical Christmas toy shop. In this captivating holiday sorting game, find and match identical toys and Christmas decorations, organizing them on the shelves. Your goal is to gather three identical items together to create a triplet and clear the shelves.

title: Grenade Simulator
description: Begin the most explosive simulator experience ever. Grenade Simulator is an adrenaline-pumping explosion simulator where you can freely throw grenades, drop mines, and trigger massive blasts. This isn’t just a casual game.

title: Turbo Race 3D
description: Get ready for intense action in Turbo Race 3D! Upgrade your car’s speed, acceleration, grip, and brakes to dominate the competition. Use shields and boosters to gain an edge, and customize your ride with decals and colors. Race through 3 exciting worlds—city, desert, and snow—while evading traffic and outpacing opponents on thrilling highways. Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate racer?

title: Dynamons 8
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 8! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Chinese Festival world and the bonus cave.

Seasoned Dynamons connoisseur Jovani will tell you everything you need to know to become a true Dynamon Captain. Encounter Robocanyx, Jaxaguar, Sauryx, Dagaryx and Tydonyx and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: Diamondz
description: DiamondZ is a special variant of Match-3. Here, the goal is not to directly manipulate jewels on the board but to insert them on the left or right side to eliminate groups and make diamonds fall into the mine carts. Help the little miner collect as much wealth as possible!

title: Metro Escape
description: On Metro escape you must search the room for items that will help you escape. Search for itens in the metro and use them to solve the puzzles. Look carefully at the various patterns around the metro and solve the riddles. Good luck to search for your way to escape!

title: Idle Casino Manager Tycoon
description: Have you ever fantasized about being a millionaire casino mogul? Embark on a thrilling journey as an enterprising capitalist tycoon, steering your way through idle profits. Amass a fortune and transform into a wealthy business magnate! Begin with a modest casino and embark on a mission to elevate your enterprise and ascend as a tycoon of capitalism. Expand your casino by constructing new floors, boosting your idle funds, and upgrading the premises for an unforgettable gambling experience!

title: Guinea Piggy Matching
description:
Guinea Piggy Match uses well known and easy to learn game mechanics. Your target is to take apart a pattern made of tiles. 
For each completed level, you are given a golden puzzle piece. For these, you can uncover images of cute guinea piggies.

title: Chibi Doll Coloring & Dress Up
description:
Chibi avatar character creator: anime coloring book and dress up games for girls
First chibi dolls coloring book: meet the most customizable Anime Avatar Maker! Color pictures, become a real doll designer, create and makeover adorable anime characters with baby doll dress up games for girls and glitter coloring pages! (✧∀✧)/

title: Mushroom Fever Match 3
description:
Immerse yourself in the magical forest with Mushroom Fever - Match 3! Bright and cheerful mushrooms replace traditional crystals, adding a fresh twist to the classic match-3 genre. This game will bring you hours of thrilling fun and bursts of excitement!

Match groups of three or more mushrooms, complete engaging tasks, and unlock new levels! Each level brings unique puzzles and fresh challenges. The more matches you make, the more points and bonuses you’ll earn!

title: Merge cubes 2048 3D
description: A completely new approach to the classic game 2048?! Now in 3D and with dynamic physics?! Number cubes don't just merge - they bounce and collide?, adding an element of surprise to every game! Compete with friends or colleagues?!

title: Angry Flappy
description: "Angry Flappy is a fast-paced twist on the classic game, where players not only navigate through obstacles but also shoot bullets to destroy enemies and barriers. Get ready for an action-packed flying adventure!"

title: Jewel Miner Quest
description: The dazzling world of gems awaits! Participate in thrilling events within limited moves or time. Solve captivating puzzles, complete fun tasks, and enjoy daily bonuses. Discover many terrific surprises with every move and see how far you can go.

title: Table Tennis Open
description: Discover a casual, easy-to-play game for hours of endless fun. Face off against your opponent, bounce the ball as its speed increases, and aim for the highest score. Earn coins with each hit to upgrade your racket!

title: The Bodyguard
description: Players will have to save the future boss. You will have to take control of a bodyguard. The bodyguard is forced to protect the boss with his body, whom they are trying to attack. The main task is to save the boss.

title: Sniper Master
description: Take aim in mid-air and strike at the perfect moment! In Sniper Master, you jump, float, and fire while airborne—time your shots to eliminate targets with clean, satisfying hits. Stay calm, lead your aim, and master precision shooting across multiple levels. Earn rewards, improve your skills, and become the ultimate airborne marksman.

title: Wednesday Addams Beauty Salon
description: Get spooky and stylish in Wednesday Addams Beauty Salon, where gothic meets glam in a 3-level makeover game. Treat Wednesday to a facial, apply stunning dark-themed makeup, and finish off with iconic dress-up fashion in her unique style. From skincare to eyeliner, you control every detail of her transformation. Whether you’re a fan of the Addams aesthetic or just love alternative beauty, this salon experience offers a complete glow-up from head to toe.

title: Celebrity Spring Fashion Trends
description: Welcome to Celebrity Spring Fashion Trends. Hello little girls. Are you ready for the latest spring fashion collection? Follow the latest fashion trends with these celebrities and create your own fashion clothes for next spring season. Browse their wardrobe to pick suitable outfits and costumes. Join and help them to welcome their favorite season.

title: My Cottagecore Aesthetic Look
description: Welcome to the My Cottagecore Aesthetic Look game. Cottagecore fashion is inspired by farm life, it is very impractical for doing chores around the farm! Princess Elsa, Anna, and Ariel are best friends planning to try something special. Get ready to explore the Cottagecore fashion style along with them to create the cutest looks!

title: Bubble Shooter Candy Wheel Level Pack
description: Bubble Shooter Candy Wheel Level Pack is a fun and challenging game where you shoot candy bubbles to match three or more on a rotating wheel. Use power-ups like the Bomb to blast nearby candies and the Stopwatch to freeze time for unlimited moves. Earn coins by clearing levels and use them to unlock more exciting levels. With increasing difficulty and sweet rewards, this game promises endless fun. Spin, aim, and conquer the candy wheel!

title: Sprunky Incredibox Mods
description:
How many sprunki can you imagine in one game? What if they are all collected together?!
In "Sprunki Incredibox Mods" you will have access to:

-10 different mods for your sprunki
-200 sprunki skins for your favorite characters
-Unique sounds for special sprunki
-Many places for your unique group

Click play and find out what other characters are waiting for you in the game "Sprunki Incredibox Mods"!

title: Word Art – Color Book Puzzle
description: Discover a delightful gaming experience that combines the thrill of solving word puzzles with the joy of bringing art to life. In Word Art – Color Book Puzzle, you’ll embark on a creative journey where words are the key to unlocking vibrant colors and stunning illustrations.

title: Majestic Dragons Merge
description:
In the days of old, dragons wander the lands as the master of all. Breathe fire and plunder all the riches in Majestic Dragons!

Majestic Dragons is an idle merge game where you merge together similar objects to obtain new things. Help your baby dragons grow into fearsome, majestic beasts! Watch them roam freely across the lands and accumulate riches for you.

Do you know how to train a dragon? Come play now and let's find out!

title: Sisyphus Simulator
description: An addictive and challenging hyper-casual 3D game. Push the rock up the hill cleverly so that it won't fall down. Reach the top of the hill and collect the honor star to complete the challenge and raise your name on the Honor Board.

title: Two Dots Remastered
description: Welcome to Two Dots Remastered, a fun and popular HTML5 connecting game enjoyed by gamers of all ages! Two Dot Remastered’s gameplay is straightforward: Match two or more dots in the same color (not diagonal ones) and then blast them! Enjoy playing Two Dots Remastered, the ultimate connecting game for gamers of all ages, and become a master at connecting dots!

title: Winter Maze
description:
Step into a frosty puzzle adventure with Winter Maze! Explore icy, snow-covered mazes and guide your ball through slippery, twisty paths that fill up with every move. Each level challenges you to think ahead, plan your route and clear the entire field to unlock the next stage.
Simply swipe to roll the ball in any direction and watch the maze come to life beneath you. Your goal is clear: cover every tile and leave no space untouched.

title: Find the Vampire
description: Looking for an exciting vampire game? This is a casual 3D game where you act as a hunter to put an end to the vampire uprising. Your task is to identify the bloodsuckers among us, destroy them and free the city from the threat.

title: ASMR Beauty Treatment
description: OMG! Our patient arrived with a dirty, pimply face and teeth problems. Help her take care of these issues and showcase your medical skills by performing this ASMR Beauty Treatment game. After completing the treatment, style our patient with the best outfit and makeup from our collections to create the perfect look!

title: DayCare Tycoon
description: Are you ready to build your dream business empire and be a great babysitter in this money tycoon simulator ? Dive into the world of daycare games and experience the joy of managing your own thriving idle tycoon games. From welcoming adorable babies to creating a safe and happy environment, this game offers everything you need to grow your daycare business into a successful venture.

title: Poppy PlayTime 3 Game
description:
The new online game Poppy PlayTime 3 is based on the well-known Poppy Playtime character, and you may play it for free. A world of fear and oppression awaits you in this new game. There are two chapters to choose from, each with its own set of goals and maps.

First, you'll find yourself stranded in a deserted mansion; to escape, you'll need to collect keys to each room and unlock them. Before the horrible Poppy and her friend locate you, you'd better get moving and go.

title: Sweet Triple Mahjong
description: Sweet Triple Mahjong is a relaxing yet challenging tile-matching puzzle game with a delicious candy theme. Match three identical tiles that are free on the left or right to collect them and clear the board. Each level introduces new tile layouts that test your observation and strategy skills. Easy to learn but hard to master, Sweet Triple Mahjong offers smooth gameplay, colorful visuals, and satisfying progression across multiple levels.

title: Superhero Drop and Save
description: Our Super Hero is ready to save the hostages captured by the bad guys. To destroy the bad guys, jump on them and neutralize them by firing small explosions. Act carefully to avoid damaging the hostages from the explosions. You can unlocked new hero skins from the market section with the money you earn. As the levels progress, the tasks will become more difficult, but you can overcome them.

title: Geometry Stars
description: Enjoy the Geometry Stars world with a brand new adventure! New levels, new music, new monsters, new everything!. Flex your clicky finger as you jump, fly and flip your way through dark caves and spiky obstacles. Collect many stars as you can to upgrade your famous characters and find the secrets of this Rhythm-based adventure.

title: Bitball
description:
A unique tile ball puzzle game from coin base bitcoin games loved by millions of players around the world. 
Make a lot of coins and become a rich. ?
 - Start with 10 and start making millions. ?
 - Coun you rech the topmillioners.❓
 - Play with friend together.?
 - Guess the ball where it will go.?

title: Frog.io
description: Frog io is a 2D PvP game where players control frogs battling for dominance. Use your frog's tongue to devour other players and grow bigger and stronger! As you explore the map, eat fruits and enemy frogs to boost your size and power. But beware other players are after you too! Outsmart them, grow massive, and become the top frog in this dynamic and competitive io game.

title: Travel Mahjong Deluxe
description: Travel Mahjong Deluxe is a relaxing tile-matching puzzle where you match identical tiles and strategically clear the board. Find pairs of beautiful travel-themed tiles that are free on at least one side and remove them to complete each level. As you progress, new layouts and challenges will keep the game fresh and engaging. Use the Hint feature whenever you get stuck, or watch a reward video to gain unlimited time and continue your puzzle-solving adventure.

title: Ultra Realistic BlockCraft
description: Help Steve in the ultra-realistic block world and make sure he reaches the portal. Remember, this realistic world is extremely challenging and monsters are roaming everywhere. You must collect all the diamonds. While collecting diamonds, don’t forget to open the chests you find along the way. Open the chests and crush all the monsters. Reach the portal at the end of the level safely to complete the stage. Remember, you only have one life and if it runs out you will lose everything you’ve earned.

title: Cute Craft Lab
description: Step into the colorful world of Cute Craft Lab, a super casual game where creativity shines and every girl can become a true crafting designer. If you love relaxing gameplay mixed with adorable creativity, this cute design adventure is made just for you. In Cute Craft Lab, enter a magical workshop filled with charming tools, sparkling decorations, and endless crafting possibilities.

title: EQ Test Puzzle
description: A puzzle game that tests emotional intelligence through emotion recognition and jigsaw puzzles. Match emotional icons, scenarios, and puzzle pieces to train your emotional awareness and problem-solving skills.

title: Pinball Basketball
description: A captivating fusion of classic arcade pinball excitement and thrilling sports gameplay. Flip your paddle skillfully to keep the ball in play, aiming for the basketball hoop while enjoying the stunning minimalist art and responsive design that make every moment electrifying and addictive.

title: My Purrfect Cat Hotel
description: Welcome to My Purrfect Cat Hotel, a super cute cat hotel simulation management game. Enjoy cute and vivid cartoon cat animations. This is the vacation spot for all meow stars, and your mission is to create the most cozy cat hotel. Serving a variety of adorable cats and catering to their needs. Make your hotel the most popular animal tycoon hotel.

title: Hide and Build a Bridge!
description:
Welcome to the exciting world of "Hide and Build a Bridge"!

In this exciting game your goal is to collect blocks on the level and build a bridge from them to the portal. But be careful! There are also other players in the level who are trying to reach the goal together with you, and a seeker who breaks bridges and catches runners.

title: Kingdom Cats
description: Become friends with the King of Cats and build a whole kingdom together! Dive into a colorful, exciting world where you can fully demonstrate your creativity!

title: Live Star Doll Dress Up
description: Discover the makeover world of fashion and fun in Live Star Doll Dress Up Games! Immerse yourself in an interactive magic princess universe! In this dress-up anime simulator, you're in charge. Dress up your doll in trendy outfits. Get creative with makeup and personalize your cute doll!

title: Bubble Shooter HD 3
description: Bubble Shooter HD 3 is the long-awaited third sequel to the the legendary Bubble Shooter game. Bubble Shooter HD 3 features the classic Bubble Shooter HD gameplay with a set of fresh new bubbles, the option to choose between the arrow vs pointer when shooting bubbles as well as the mighty BOMB feature that lets you blow up 15 bubbles at once. So what is the highest score you can achieve? Enjoy Bubble Shooter HD 3 now and break a new record!

title: Pirate Noob Apocalypse
description: It's time to enjoy yourself with this Pirate Noob Apocalypse game. A little pirate noob is getting ready to go out and battle many zombies that have arisen to take over the planet and all seafaring vessels. You may have a great time playing this engaging action and shooting game and rising to the position of the greatest pirate around.

title: Knife Master : Ball Racing
description:
Chop chop chop, throw the knife, but don't hit the ball~!
It's like the mastery of circus performer. Which means, it's fun! Let's be the master of throwing knives and bounce the ball to the sky!

title: Blue VS Red
description: Sort blue and red items as fast as you can! Drag or use arrow keys to send each item to the correct zone. Build combos, beat the timer, and earn coins to buy power-ups. Challenge yourself in solo mode or compete against AI bots. How high can you score in 30 seconds?

title: Ballistic Breakthrough
description: explore lush scenes, tackle tricky obstacles, and unlock upgrades. Every level blends fun challenges with strategic boosts

title: Riders Downhill Racing
description: Get ready to join the riders in an exciting adventure with Riders Downhill Racing! Choose from various game modes, including free ride, race, and career, available in both 1 player and 2 player modes. Experience the thrill of riding different vehicles, such as ATV bikes, cross bikes, and speed boats, while wearing different costumes. Join any mode and have a blast! Remember to collect diamonds during the free ride to unlock more items.

title: Brother!Follow Me! - Merge Men
description:
It's a 3D running game where you control a runner as you navigate various obstacles, overcome challenges, and face off against a boss at the end of each level. This action-packed game combines exciting competitions, battles, and intense conflicts.

Collect and lead your brothers along the way, and grow your team to challenge the final game.

title: Seat Puzzle Cut The Rope
description: Face a wildly satisfying brain challenge in Seat Puzzle - Cut The Rope. This addictive puzzle game blends smart logic with relaxing casual gameplay, creating the perfect experience for those who love thinking fast and solving clever challenges! In each level, chairs are bound by ropes. Your task is to cut the ropes according to the passengers' colors.

title: Cat Football
description: Enter the adorable world of Cat Football, where cute felines don caps and engage in soccer madness! Score goals using a ball of blue thread against cardboard box goals. Compete with friends or challenge a skilled computer opponent in time-limited matches filled with frantic fun!

title: Stickman Rogue Online
description: Get ready for an exciting stickman adventure! You will enter an exciting survival battlefield.Fight nervous battles against increasing enemies constantly. Collect experience points and progress through endless waves of enemies. Each wave of enemies is more challenging, so be careful to upgrade your skills to survive! Collect energy boosters in battle to upgrade your stickman skills. Increase speed, increase attack or increase defense.

title: Colors Runners
description: Colors Runners is an interesting game that you can not miss. Slide to gather your companions of the same color and rush to the finishing line. Remember to walk the same way as your body color or you will get shot and fail. Challenge this game now!

title: Basket Swap
description: Slide into the gray blocks to help you position the ball and grid correctly. If you're stuck, click on the arrow in the bottom left corner to undo your last move, or press R to restart the level.

title: Art Salon
description: Welcome to Art Salon - Makeup & Nails, where your creativity knows no bounds! ? Whether you're passionate about fashion, beauty care, or just looking for a fun, relaxing game, this is the perfect app for you. From designing acrylic nails to creating stunning makeup looks, step into a world of endless beauty transformations in 3D! ??

title: Color Conquest: Territory War
description:
Command one of 4 unique factions in this intense RTS war! Capture territories to expand your army and destroy enemy bases.

Factions:

Grey: High HP (Tank), slow production.

Green: Fast spawn (Swarm), low HP.

Blue & Yellow: Balanced fighters.

Capture neutral zones to increase your unit capacity. Can you dominate the map?

title: Agents io
description:
Play Agents.io online! Eliminate other agents, grow your team, and dominate the arena in this free game.
Agents.io is a multiplayer action game where you control a lone agent and battle against others in an open arena. As you eliminate enemies, they join your team, allowing you to grow your squad and become stronger. The more agents you collect, the easier it is to dominate your opponents. Use smart tactics, avoid bigger squads, and climb to the top of the leaderboard!

title: Crazy Screw King
description: This is Unscrew All! More than simple matching, swiftly remove screws into same-colored bins. Glass slides down with each success! Release stress, show skill, become the Screw Master!

title: Insta Trends Galaxy Fashion
description: Embark on a fashionable trip to the center of the Universe with your favorite princesses while playing the Insta Trends: Galaxy Fashion dress-up game for girls. Elsa, Anna, Moana, Ariel, and Rapunzel recently found Planet Her, and they are super excited to share their new home with you. Fashion on this amazing planet is galaxy colored and centered around fashionable suits and out-of-this-world accessories. Discover them all while helping the girls choose their outfits for the day! Have fun!

title: Fishing Bear
description:
Tap to reel in your fishing line and catch as many fish as you can!
But stay alert—mischievous creatures in the sea will try to get in your way.
And when you pick up a mysterious Treasure Shell… something exciting might happen!
Enjoy a simple and addictive fishing experience!

title: Yummy Tales 3
description: Join Oscar, the clever farm dog, in Yummy Tales 3 — the fun and addictive Match 3 puzzle game! Match 3 or more fruits and veggies to feed your farm animals and reach level goals before you run out of moves. Enjoy over 2500+ exciting levels, daily missions, and challenges. Collect daily gifts, boosters, and fantastic rewards to help you beat tricky puzzles. Harvest the fun and start playing Yummy Tales 3 now!

title: Cubica
description:
Get lost in a tranquil atmosphere with Cubica, a fun puzzle game designed to relax with a simple brain teaser. It's very simple! Blast blocks of identical colored cubes to make them disappear, making room for new ones. No rush, no complicated rules, just enjoy the game.
Immerse yourself in soft colors, pleasant sounds, and smooth gameplay that will allow you to forget about the hustle and bustle.

title: Idle Town Billionaire
description: Dive into the world of entrepreneurship by purchasing lots in the town and building a variety of businesses. This idle game allows your businesses to automatically generate profit, even while you're away. Hire managers to boost your earnings and optimize your operations. Expand your business empire by strategically investing in new properties and upgrades.

title: Mojo Emoji
description: Moji Emoji is a fun and clever word/emoji puzzle game where each level challenges you to guess the hidden word or phrase from a set of expressive emojis. Think fast, connect the clues, and test your emoji decoding skills across hundreds of creative puzzles.

title: Kitty Match 3 puzzle game
description:
Kitty Match is a fun and addictive match-3 puzzle game with adorable cats. Match tiles, create combos, and clear levels in a relaxing and colorful world.

Easy to play and perfect for all ages. Enjoy smooth gameplay and endless puzzle fun.

Start your cute cat adventure now!

title: Zombie Driver
description:
Zombie Driver features: - multiple cars - upgrades - multiple levels - fun gameplay
Personalize your car by changing its weapon or its armor. Also, you can buy new car models in the store. Kill all zombies in your way, gather as

title: Valley of Wolves Ambush
description: Valley Of Wolves Ambush is an action-packed survival game where waves of enemies attack your fortress. Your mission is to protect the fortress without leaving the area. Each wave brings more enemies, making the fight harder. If the enemies capture your fortress or defeat you, the game ends. Earn money by defeating enemies to buy better weapons. The most fun part? You can jump really high! Experience intense battles in a realistic war zone. Can you survive?

title: Word Search with hints
description: Search for hidden words on the letter grid. Use hints to solve words and improve your skills. This game is great for players of all ages, and it's a fun way to spend time and test mental abilities!

title: Thor Merge
description:
Dive into Norse mythology in Thor’s Merge! 
Merge planets representing the Nine Realms to create even bigger worlds. 
Play solo to reach the highest score or battle others in PvP mode to climb the leaderboard and achieve ultimate glory in Asgard!

title: Real Freekick 3D
description: Immerse yourself in the intensity of Real Freekick 3D, a penalty shootout game where the championship's fate hangs on a nail-biting series of penalty shots. Select your preferred soccer team and progress to the finals. The pressure is on – make every shot count!

title: Fruit Match
description:
A fresh twist on fruit puzzles!
Tap two identical fruits to detach them and send them falling into the basket.

But it’s not that simple — fruits follow real physics. They can get stuck, stack, and only fall further when you clear what’s below.
Use gravity to your advantage, trigger chain reactions, and watch satisfying cascades unfold.

Clear the board and keep the flow going as new fruits drop in!

title: Save my Hero
description:
Players may enjoy a unique gaming experience in Save my Hero Online, an engaging puzzle game that revolves on drawing lines. You take on the role of a superhero under assault from missiles in the game. It is your responsibility to create lines to stop these projectiles and shield the hero.

Finish every level and attempt to rescue the superheroes, such as Iron Man, Batman, Spider-Man, and so on.

title: Guess The Italian Brainrot Animals
description: Get ready for a wild and hilarious ride with Guess the Italian Brainrot Animals, a fast-paced, emoji-fueled trivia game that tests your knowledge of 64 iconic Italian Brainrot characters! From the most famous to the obscure, this game challenges you to guess the correct character based on three emoji clues before the timer runs out. Think you’re a Brainrot expert? Prove it!

title: Code Maze
description: Master programming logic with Code Maze! Use code blocks to navigate mazes, overcome obstacles, and reach goals. Each level challenges your problem-solving skills. Ready to code your way out?

title: Mojicon Spring Connect
description:
The 5th Mojicon game is here! Relax and enjoy the peaceful Spring season. Guided by your cheerful and cheeky Bunny companion, embark on a soothing puzzle journey to bring a barren landscape back to life. Match tactile spring tiles to clear the board and earn rewards!

Restore the Meadow: Follow a heartwarming story.
Collect Cards: Find 34 beautiful "Spring Wisdoms".
Relax: Enjoy classic tile-matching mechanics.
Achievements: Go for 100% completion!

title: Triple Tile Twister Match Game
description: Triple Tile Twister: Match Game is a relaxing puzzle with a twist on mahjong. Clear the board by matching groups of three identical tiles. ?✨ Strategically select tiles to move to the holding area, which holds up to 7 tiles. Create sets of three to clear them, but watch out! ? If the area fills with unmatched tiles, the game ends. Enjoy soothing graphics and relaxing gameplay—perfect for unwinding! ? Great for both mahjong fans and newcomers! ?

title: Home Block Story
description: Step into a world of renovation! Match blocks, clear the board and unlock new decor to design your house just the way you want. With each new challenge, show your unique style and make your dream home a reality.

title: Black Pink St.Patricks day Concert
description: Step into the glamorous world of Black Pink St. Patrick’s Day Concert, the ultimate dress-up game! Style your favorite Black Pink members with trendy outfits, accessories, and makeup to make them shine for their St. Patrick’s Day performance. With simple controls and endless creativity, this game is perfect for quick fun or long gaming sessions.

title: 2-3-4 Player Games
description: These games can be played with 2, 3, or 4 players. You can play 21 unique games with your friends, each with different scenarios. The objective of each game is to either score or be the first to reach the finish line. Move swiftly and outpace your opponents! It's time to enjoy with friends!

title: Cat Cut
description: A fun game about a hungry cat, get him a fish, cut the rope so that it falls directly to the cat. All objects move according to physics, do not miss the fish, do not upset the cat!

title: Red Escape
description: In Red Escape you must search for useful items in the series of rooms to help you escape. Look carefully around the rooms, and use your logic to solve the riddles. Find your way to escape!

title: Safe Merge
description: A simple idle merge game, you need to merge safes with same design to make a safe more powerfull, you need to unlock all design to win the game, the design are in the right, if the game was hard you can do prestige to win more money per cicle.

title: Super Slime
description: Super Slime is a fast-paced platformer where you take control of a squishy, bouncy hero on a mission to save the day. Master the art of stretching, bouncing, and dodging through 100 thrilling levels packed with tricky obstacles and fierce enemies. Precision and quick reflexes are your best allies in this adorable yet challenging adventure!

title: Venetian Love Affair
description: Go to the festive Venice and become a fashion stylist for two girlfriends, each of whom dreams of an unforgettable fancy dress. Create unique masks with great designs and choose luxurious Baroque dresses, jewelry and accessories. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of mystery and romance of the Venetian carnival. Unleash your talent as a fashion designer in a unique way for the masquerade participants. Get ready for a magical journey into the world of love and mysteries!

title: Truck Simulator Arcade Championship
description: Truck Simulator Arcade Championship is an exhilarating truck racing game that combines the intensity of high-speed competition with the precision of driving massive, powerful trucks. This game offers an action-packed arcade-style experience where players take control of different types of trucks and compete in various challenging racing events across diverse tracks and terrains.

title: Words with Prof. Wisely
description:
ind words by connecting letters. Improve your attentiveness, train your brain!

Keep in mind - some crosswords will be difficult to solve.

title: Make America Great Again
description: Take control of a powerful character in the center of the ring, facing waves of wrestlers charging from the right. Your reflexes will be tested as you press directional buttons to deliver well-timed punches and knock out the incoming opponents. As you progress, you'll unlock special abilities that temporarily increase the strength of your punches, allowing you to knock out multiple enemies in a line with a single powerful blow.

title: Wipe Insight Master
description: Dop 3: Draw One Part is a free drawing online game for boys. Use your finger to draw and outline the shapes of the parts that the drawings need. Solve puzzles by using your powers of logic and lateral thinking as you work your way through a huge series of cute drawings that all have something a little bit wrong with them, it's up to you to work it out!

title: Merge Run Battle
description: Merge Runner is an exciting merge game where you combine power and speed to win every challenge. Play a merge runner game with fun arcade merge game mechanics like those in cool math games or reminiscent of roblox and minecraft thrills. Upgrade heroes in an idle merge game and fight in a merge battle game. This merge and run game blends strategy and fast-paced action—perfect for fans of snake game challenges or quick kahoot-style fun.

title: Stickman Miners Wars
description: Lead your stickman king to victory in Stickman Miners Wars, where strategic decision-making is key. Command an army of miners and warriors to build your forces and triumph over opponents. Upgrade your units and yourself as you gain experience, and strategically attack enemy castles while defending your own. Will your strategy lead you to dominance? Play Stickman Miners Wars now!

title: Draw Bridge Puzzle
description: Draw Bridge Puzzle is a creative and exciting puzzle game that combines drawing and rescue gameplay into one addictive experience. You become a bridge designer, using your finger to draw safe paths and complete thrilling rescue missions. Enter the car mode, draw a strong bridge to help a motor cross gaps, broken roads, and dangerous obstacles to reach the goal.

title: Fierce Battle Breakout
description:
This is a fast-paced 3D mini-game that combines survival, combat and strategy. Players will play the role of survivors striving for survival. Facing the threats from enemies, the pursuit of hostile forces and the harsh environment, they will embark on a thrilling journey of survival and defense.
The difficulty of the levels will keep increasing. Each level has a large number of enemies constantly swarming towards the players. Players need to eliminate all the enemies to win.

title: Soo Match: Room Design
description: Soo Match! is a fun and engaging blast game. Players progress by tapping and matching blocks of the same color to complete levels. At the end of each level, tickets can be used to complete rooms and unlock new stages, while in-game coins can be spent to acquire new characters. With its charming graphics and diverse game modes, Soo Match! offers a dynamic and enjoyable gaming experience.

title: Bubble Shooter Wonders of Egypt
description: Journey into an ancient Egyptian night in Bubble Shooter Pyramid Quest! Match and pop glossy bubbles to climb rising score goals. Fill the goal bar to trigger quick celebrations, then push onward as the ceiling creeps closer. Beat your High score, earn a second chance with a rewarded continue, and watch desert backdrops shift as you progress. Easy to start, hard to master—aim, bounce, and clear your way to legend! Start in Beginner, then unlock Medium and Hard as your score surges ever higher!

title: Level Up Mutants
description: Level Up Mutants: An Awesome Casual Game.Discover the fun of training monsters in Level Up Mutants, the most addictive casual game ever! Combine different monsters to create dinosaurs and other powerful creatures. Level up your mutants and challenge your opponents. Test your hand speed and strategy skills. Can you become the best monster designer? Try Level Up Mutants now and have fun!

title: Granny's Classroom Nightmare
description: Step into the eerie halls of Granny's Classroom Nightmare, a horror survival game that blends the terrifying atmosphere of Granny Horror with the unsettling chill of an abandoned school. Trapped in an old, decaying classroom with Granny as your relentless pursuer, you must uncover hidden clues, solve twisted puzzles, and avoid her watchful gaze to escape. Each room holds a dark secret from a haunted past, and the slightest noise can summon Granny

description: Clap Clap is a short indie horror game that puts you in the shoes of a house sitter, experiencing strange occurrences in a seemingly ordinary home.

title: Jixora – Jigsaw Solitaire Puzzle
description: Jixora is a relaxing jigsaw solitaire puzzle game where you piece together beautiful artwork. Journey through 100 unique levels with increasing difficulty, or unlock Free Play mode to replay your favorites with custom grid sizes. Race against the clock to earn stars, use strategic power-ups like Hints and Time Freezes, and immerse yourself in a cinematic atmosphere with soothing music.

title: Football Legends 2026
description: Football Legends 2026 is a fast-paced arcade soccer game where you can play solo or challenge your friends in exciting 1v1 and 2v2 matches. Choose from a variety of unique players, each with special abilities like powerful superkicks or teleportation, and use them to outplay your opponents. Compete in tournaments, master your timing and strategy, and score incredible goals to become the ultimate soccer champion

title: Stick Hero Battle
description: Stick Hero Battle is a fast-paced and explosive action fighting game that throws you straight into intense battle arenas. The game features easy-to-learn controls with deep combat mechanics. Control a fearless stick hero and fight your way through waves of enemies using powerful attacks, smart movement, and perfect timing.

title: Hill Climbing Mania
description: Drive over hilly tracks, collect stars, coins and pickups to upgrade your cars and get further! Also watch out for various obstacles! But you can also use them to perform some backflips... just watch your head! So, buckle up, driver! Drive from the start to finish in each level and collect coins to upgrade your cars.

title: Tile Match: The Immersive Puzzle
description:
Match. Merge. Master the Tiles!
Dive into Tile Match: The Immersive Experience, a satisfying and relaxing puzzle game where your goal is to match three identical tiles to clear the board.

description: Welcome to Car Park Simulator, Are you ready to test your driving skills and master the art of parking? Navigate through 72 challenging levels filled with obstacles and narrow spaces...

title: Nitro Speed Car Racing
description:
Nitro Speed Car Racing is a very unique racing game. You need to focus on the pointer on the dial and stop it at the right moment to get the Nitro that can help you rush to the finish line. This
is a test of your quick reaction ability. Of course, you can use the coins you collected in the game to upgrade your engine and nitro. Come to a brain contest, stimulate your dopamine, and
challenge your reflex limit!

title: Merge Food Puzzle
description: Merge Food Puzzle is a synthetic puzzle game. What is different from ordinary match-3 games is that successful matches will not disappear and will generate higher-level food. The game has two modes: Merge BBQ and Merge Fruit. Merge BBQ has a variety of barbecues waiting for you to unlock, including corn, cauliflower, fish, squid, and more. Have fun!

title: Stealth Master Sneak Cat
description: Stealth Master: Sneak Cat is a fun stealth adventure game that lets you play the role of a cute cat. You will sneak through various missions! Move quietly under the close watch of enemies and surveillance equipment.

title: Hopnova
description: Hopnova is a fastpaced vertical adventure where every jump takes you closer to the stars. Guide your little explorer across floating platforms, avoid dangers, and discover powerups that boost you higher and higher. Chase new heights, beat your best scores, and enjoy quick, addictive gameplay perfect for short, exciting sessions.

title: That's my seat!
description: That's My Seat! is a fun and engaging logic puzzle game where you must place characters in the correct seats by analyzing clues. Each level presents a new seating challenge with unique rules and relationships between the characters. Study the hints, think carefully, and figure out where everyone belongs. Perfect for fans of logic puzzles, brain games, deduction games, and casual puzzle games that test your thinking skills.

title: Scary Shawarma Kiosk: The Anomaly
description: This is a first-person psychological horror game where you work night shifts in a small street kiosk. What seems like a normal job quickly turns into a nightmare: customers grow increasingly strange, and reality itself begins to warp. Some people just want to eat — others are only pretending to be human.

title: Devs Simulator
description: Welcome to the world of high technology and business! In this exciting strategy game you will become the director of a thriving IT company. Your task is to find the best programmers, assemble a dream team and lead it to success!

title: Vex X3M
description:
VEX X3M, a new extreme hill racing game with bike stunts and obstacles, is here! 
Enjoy the classic Vex elements, but this time you will be racing your way to the finish line! 

Perform crazy bike stunts in 30 unique levels filled with danger - from spikes and shooting knives to rockets and lasers. Reach the finish safely and obtain stars to unlock new unique bike skins.

Complete all levels in easy and hard mode to crown yourself a master VEX X3M Rider.

Start your engines and enjoy VEX X3M!

title: Geometry Dash Maze Maps V2
description: Welcome to Geometry Dash Maze Maps V2. It's a test of your agility and intelligence as you guide the square through thrilling challenges. The game features six levels, each filled with tricky mazes. The cube will automatically rush forward at a fast pace, making it challenging to keep up. Your goal is to navigate through the obstacles in time. Jump over sharp spikes, leap onto platforms, and make use of the yellow boosters to soar even higher.

title: Kingdom Wars TD
description: Welcome to Kingdom Wars TD, an exciting tower-defense strategy game set in a captivating 2D kingdom. Assume the role of a skilled commander entrusted with the defense of a mighty castle. In your quest, assemble a formidable army comprising up to five soldiers, including archers, warriors, and priests. Brace yourself for the challenge of surviving two perilous waves across various meticulously designed levels scattered throughout the map. Immerse yourself in this thrilling adventure!

title: Easter Shadow Match
description: It is an educational as well as fun game for kids. Just look the photo displayed in the left box and click correct shadow of the photo in right panels. Each time you select correct shadow, 200 points will be added to your score. On clicking the wrong shadow 40 points will be deducted from your score.

title: Wordmeister HD
description:
Create words in the English dictionary to score points. Drag and drop the tiles to form words.

Take advantage of bonus tiles such as double letter scores, triple word scores and more. How well-versed are you with the English vocabulary?

The highest score wins!

title: Goods Sorting Shopping Master
description: In Goods Sorting Shopping Master, you organize messy goods by moving and matching them into neat groups. It’s a fun puzzle game that combines smart thinking with relaxing gameplay. In the game, you’ll face shelves filled with mixed goods such as drinks, snacks, and daily items. Match and sort three identical items to clear the space and proceed, based on the customer's needs. Manage space carefully to keep sorting.

title: Classic Mahjong
description:
"Mahjong Classic" is a classic mahjong solitaire with a unique algorithm for generating levels - a random layout of chips always has a solution! Each playthrough becomes unique, allowing you to play your favorite fields an unlimited amount of times!
In the game you will find popular fields: Turtle, Fort, Crab, Spider, Cat, Dragon and many others.
Play solitaire at your own pace, there is no time limit!

title: Lambo Traffic Racer
description: Lambo Traffic Racing, you will be playing lambo cars through endless highway. It is a great game for kids and adults. Great fun, great graphics and great lambos to drive .

title: Ole Bunny
description: Ole Bunny plunges you into a crazy arena where a cute bunny finds himself because of his love for roses ! Now you must show courage and skill to escape the wild bulls and collect as many fragrant roses as possible. Can you become the best bunny matador of all time?

description:
Street - it's no matter build your modern city life or just stick with village-like town world you always be enjoy with it! 

Room - decorate and design home girly world.

Dress Up Games - match and mix more than 5000+ girly items for dressing up princess: hairstyle, clothes, hats, accessories, freckles, moles, blush, wings, tails.

title: Tap Bead
description: Tap Bead is a relaxing puzzle game. Arrange beads by color to match patterns and clear levels. Simple controls, soft visuals, and many levels make it a soothing, satisfying experience.

title: Small Wardrobe
