The game offers a variety of adorable doll clothes, shoes, and accessories. Let's happily organize and tidy up the doll's wardrobe together!

title: Colossatron
description:
Take charge of a giant robotic snake and smash through cities with ease as you fight to create the most fearsome weapon of all time.
Unleash the power of Colossatron! A unique combination of Match 3 and Snake gameplay allows you to build a devastating machine by merging colored power ups to create new and more powerful weapons. With thousands of potential combinations, the key to victory lies in mastering the art of building Colossatron to take down formidable bosses.

title: Atomic Merge 2048
description:
Atomic Merge 2048 is a fast-paced puzzle game where you drop and combine numbered blocks to reach the legendary 2048 tile! Strategically  drop blocks which fall on to center , merge identical numbers, and keep the pile from touching the red orbit. Watch out — one wrong drop could be the end!
Perfect for fans of casual, merge, and puzzle games. How high can you score before the stack overflows?

title: Bubble Letters
description: Dive into the enchanting realm of Bubble Letters, an immersive word game that takes players on an extraordinary journey through the world of letters. Featuring vibrant floral backgrounds and tranquil gameplay, this online crossword adventure is the ideal companion for warm days ahead! With thousands of levels to conquer, you're guaranteed endless brain-teasing enjoyment. Embark on a blooming linguistic adventure today!

title: Dalgona Master
description:
Welcome to Dalgona Master, a thrilling game for those who loves dalgona, honeycomb, cookie game, and dalgona challenges.

This engaging sweet game challenge invites you to carve delicate shapes out of honeycomb candy, immersing you in the delicate skill required to perfect each piece without breaking it.

title: Italian Brainrot Find the Stars
description: Play Italian Brainrot Find the Stars game online and for free. Find out the hidden stars in the specified images. Each level has 12 hidden stars. There are 12 levels in total. The time is limited so be fast and find all hidden objects before time runs out. Clicking in the wrong place several times reduces the time by an additional 5 seconds. So, if you are ready, start the game and have fun!

title: Larry World
description:
A fun and challenging platformer game inspired on the greatests classics of its kind.
Help Larry to pass through 4 fantastic worlds.

title: Egg Adventure 2
description: Mr Egg comes back, and also a challenge of intelligence and imagination.In egg adventure 2,you need to operate the Eggs to solve various puzzles and get out of the door.Imaginative levels ann funny painting style will take you into a whole ner puzzle world!The key to solving the puzzle may be a word or an action, that can you give it a try？

title: Math Runner
description: Challenge your mind and reflexes in this fast-paced arithmetic adventure! Solve math problems on the run, dodge obstacles, and race against time to achieve the highest score. Perfect for players of all ages looking to sharpen their math skills while enjoying thrilling gameplay.

title: Party Games Mini Shooter Battle
description: Party Games: Mini Shooter Battle is a battle-royale shoot-em-up game with 2D cartoon models. In 4 modes, you can shoot other players to earn scores for coins and gems. Then you can buy more roles and guns in the Shop. Your character can aim at the closest target automatically so that you only need to fire and dodge bullets from enemies. More kills and less death will make you claim more coin and gem rewards. Good luck!

title: Brainrot Ice Truck
description:
Step into the wild world of Brainrot Ice Cream, where over-the-top characters and ridiculous chaos blend perfectly with sweet, frozen treats!
Run your own ice cream truck, serving unhinged yet oddly charming customers with outrageous flavor combos, absurd toppings, and just the right amount of brain freeze.
Customize your setup, upgrade your gear, and keep up with the madness as each day gets weirder than the last.
Can you scoop fast enough to satisfy this wonderfully deranged crowd?

title: Battle Racing Stars
description: Join an epic racing adventure where you can unlock and upgrade iconic characters from beloved Halfbrick games, including Barry from Jetpack Joyride, The Ginger Ninja from Dan the Man, and the nimble ninjas from Fruit Ninja.

title: Wood Nuts Master: Screw Puzzle
description:
In this physics-based innovative puzzle game, your objective is to strategically place screws and nuts to fall all the wooden blocks.
Unleash your cognitive ability as you tackle each brain-teasing level, each one designed to test your problem-solving skills. From simple puzzles to complex constructions, this 2D puzzle game offers an array of challenges suitable for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages.

title: Stunt Fury
description: Stunt Fury takes adrenaline-fueled stunts to new heights in this action-packed gaming experience. Strap in and prepare to defy gravity as you showcase your skills on a variety of daring platforms. With heart-pounding excitement around every corner, this game challenges players to push the limits of physics and creativity.

title: Sea Battle Admiral
description:
Do you remember your favorite childhood entertainment with paper and pencils?
Then, immerse yourself in the exciting sea battles on your device's screen.
The classic paper-based tabletop naval combat game is here!
Enjoy exciting naval battles, strategy, and adrenaline.

title: Cookie monster
description: What more could you ask for?! Puzzle, brain teaser, monsters, snacks...wait what? That's right MONSTERS and SNACKS! Feed the hungry monsters snacks to pass the level! You have to make sure all the snacks get into the monster's mouth though or you will see a sad face! Let's keep these monsters happy! If you like the game, leave us a review! That will help us continue to bring you many more challenging levels, new monsters, maybe some new twizzler lines.

title: Gross Out Run
description: Gross Out Run is a parkour game. Compete against two other AI runners and the first player to reach the finish line wins! Be careful, you have to avoid the sledgehammers on the road, which will block your progress and stain your clothes simultaneously. It's time to make a change! Can you get to the finish line first and keep yourself tidy?

title: Ninja Survivor
description: Become a nimble ninja and embark on a dangerous adventure through many levels filled with traps, enemies, and puzzles. Explore colorful 3D locations, avoid deadly mechanisms, and fight zombies and powerful bosses using speed, reflexes, and strategy. Each level requires focus and skill. Upgrade your character, unlock new weapons, and collect stylish skins to grow stronger and overcome increasingly difficult challenges.

title: Chrome Cars Garage
description: Dive into the world of car mechanics in this engaging hidden object game. After inheriting your grandpa's global network of garages, you take on the role of the new owner, with your Uncle Joe guiding you through the intricacies of the trade. Explore various locations, uncover hidden car parts, and learn the art of automotive repair.

title: Castle Craft
description: Embark on a mystical journey in Castle Craft, where you merge resources and unlock the secrets of time. Start in a land cloaked in fog, using ancient keys to reveal hidden territories and trace your lost family's steps across eras.

title: Bolts and nuts
description:
The game Bolts and Nuts is a logic puzzle? in which you have to unscrew bolts from planks?! Your task is to choose the right bolt to unscrew? so that you can unscrew all the planks ✌!
Compete with friends and colleagues ?!

title: Popcorn Stack
description: Welcome to Popcorn Stack! Here, you will have a fun stacking popcorn trip. Collect many boxes and fill them with grain, sprinkle them with choco, bake and other food. Pack them up, cover them, and decorate them with fancy wings.

title: Sky Block Bounce
description: Welcome to Sky Block Bounce, the ultimate test of agility and strategy in a sky-high adventure! Your mission is simple yet exhilarating: jump on the blocks and navigate your way to the teleporter. But beware, each block behaves differently—some will vanish after just one jump, while others can withstand two or more.

title: Magic Finger
description: Magic Finger 3D is a casual physics game where you use your magical powers to defeat alien foes creatively. Use your magic touch to throw enemies at each other, utilize explosive barrels for big impacts, and send adversaries off platforms. Control your surroundings by picking up and manipulating objects, becoming the ultimate magic user.

title: Mermaidcore Makeup
description: In Mermaidcore Makeup, you ladies can step into the shoes of a talented makeup artist and work your magic on three stunning ladies. Journey into the realm of fantasy as you help these beauties achieve their perfect, enchanting looks. Prepare for a sensational trip filled with endless options as you explore an extensive selection of hairstyles, eyeshadows, mascara, lipsticks, face patterns, and intricate shoulder and neck patterns that perfectly match each girl's unique style and personality.

title: Turbo Car Track
description: Get ready for an exhilarating ride with Turbo Car Track! Navigate through winding tracks that get progressively more challenging as your speed increases. Collect gold coins to unlock new, more powerful vehicles and boost your progress. Can you handle the speed and conquer the track? Find out in this thrilling, high-speed adventure!

title: Sorcerer Mahjong Marvels
description: Step into the Sorcerer Mahjong Marvels. Match mystical tiles adorned with enchanting artifacts. Collect only open tiles that don't have adjacent tiles to the left or right. Gather all the tile sets to win each level. Conquer 60 levels within the time limits to complete this game. Uncover magical secrets to become the ultimate magician!

title: Bus Collect
description: The aim of the Bus Collect game is to collect the passengers waiting on the road by making the right directions and deliver them to the finish point. To do this, direct the roads the vehicle will follow with arrow signs. Try to reach high scores by carrying as many passengers as possible to the finish point.

title: Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac
description:
Unwind and challenge your mind with Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac, a timeless puzzle game that blends strategy, focus, and relaxation. 
Match beautifully designed tiles, clear the board, and enjoy a calming gameplay experience anytime, anywhere.
Perfect for both beginners and seasoned players, Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac offers intuitive controls, elegant visuals, and satisfying puzzles that keep you coming back for more.

title: VR World
description:
If you seen VR games on TikTok where you can manipulate little people like puppets, and you like it, then this is the game for you.

- In the game, you can fight with little people and drag and manipulate them like in a VR game.
- The game runs without any special VR equipment. All you need is a computer or smartphone. It's all in the browser, no downloads required!
- The game offers various jobs, such as police officer and ambulance driver!

title: Farm Blast
description: Farm Blast is a colorful level-based blast puzzle game set on a vibrant farm. Complete exciting objectives, overcome tricky obstacles, and unlock powerful boosters as you progress through hundreds of engaging levels. With bright visuals, satisfying chain reactions, and strategic gameplay, this addictive casual puzzle game is perfect for fans of match-3 games, farm games, and relaxing yet challenging brain teasers.

title: Age of Apes Run
description: Welcome to the wildest adventure of the ape era! Age of Apes Run is a fun platform running game. It is full of puzzles and nervous battles. Perfect for every arcade-loving boy out there! You'll be a brave ape warrior and run through a platform full of obstacles! Collect many bananas to boost your skills.

title: Superheroes and the Wand
description: You will play as a Wand character who had a strange dream about a sorcerer. Soon, in reality, the sorcerer from Stickman dream appears in the city and begins to do evil. Wand, together with the Superheroes, decide to teach the sorcerer a lesson. But not everything is so easy to do. The following superheroes are waiting for you: Blushing, Green Man, Bobo, Cudgel, Bruise, Flyer, Captain Captain and others. Among the enemies will be the Wizard, Anrik, the Clown and others.

title: FreeCell
description: Unlike other card games that rely on luck, almost every game of FreeCell is solvable—if you have the skill. Use the four open "free cells" as temporary holders to juggle your cards and organize the chaotic tableau. Plan your moves carefully, stack cards by alternating colors, and clear the board. Whether you want a relaxing break or a serious brain workout, this is the perfect puzzle for you.

title: Labubu and Treasures: Fun Adventure
description: Collect bright combinations, pass hundreds of levels together with amazing characters from the Labubu universe! In this exciting Match-3 puzzle you will find bright adventures, interesting puzzles and fluffy magic.

title: Mahjong Lines
description: Mahjong Lines is a relaxing logic puzzle in the mahjong connect style. Find matching tile pairs and clear the board by linking them with a valid path. With classic mahjong tiles, simple rules, hints, and lots of levels, it’s perfect for both quick sessions and thoughtful puzzle-solving.

title: Tony Archer
description:
Evil hooligans have caught your friends, free them quickly and punish the villains!
You are the great Tony Archer, a dude who masterfully handles all types of weapons, can run fast and is a former military man! In his hands, even a stick becomes a deadly weapon! And Tony Archer knows how to stealthily eliminate enemies. Every villain in this city will be punished and all the main character's friends will be saved! Fight on city rooftops, secret laboratories and enemy military complexes.

title: Winter Mahjong
description: You can test your pattern detection skills in this relaxed mahjong & connect puzzle game with winter christmas theme. You can eliminate pair of same tiles. The line connecting the two clicked tiles can't have more than 2 corners. Some levels the tiles can auto slide( to left, to right, to up, to bottom). Can you clear the board before time runs out? Enjoying matching winter tiles with 32 levels in this game.

title: Grand Theft NY
description:
This amazing 3D game is a free online take on the legendary Grand Theft Auto game. As you play, you'll take control of a thief with assignments all throughout New York City. You have complete freedom to run and explore the game's open world.

Using the arrows to guide you to the control points, you must sprint across the city and complete over ten interactive levels.

In each level, you have the option to play missions with certain goals or just explore the world at your leisure.

title: Falling Blocks Puzzle
description: Falling Blocks Puzzle is a timeless puzzle game where players arrange falling geometric shapes, to form complete horizontal lines. As lines are completed, they disappear, and players earn points. The game ends when the stack of shapes reaches the top of the screen. It’s a test of strategy and quick thinking, beloved by gamers worldwide.

title: Daily Match
description: Connect tiles with a great number of pictures in pairs within the limited time. As you crush all the tiles on the board, you can win the level! Become a tile master level by level! Play faster and faster to train your brain and exercise the link technology!

title: Candy Jewels
description: It is a candy-filled puzzle adventure full of surprises! Match candies, break chests and collect coins as you progress through countless levels. Complete fun events like Time Attack or Coin Catch and use boosters to overcome tricky obstacles even faster!

title: Cryptogram
description:
This game is for people who do not just look at letters but see the meaning behind them.
Each phrase hides a thought that can be revealed if you use logic, intuition and persistence.

title: Slope Spooky
description: Slope Spooky is a Halloween-themed! A ball rolling down difficult and eerie slopes is controlled by the players. It's almost Halloween, which means Slope needs some scary stuff!

title: Minecraft Battle Party
description: Ready for a hot feast of square battles? In Minecraft Battle Party, you'll enter a pixel-styled battle arena where nervous fighting meets iconic Minecraft-style visuals. In this world, every game is a duel to the death. You will play different roles and use different weapons. For example, as a gunner, constantly move your character so that enemies are shot within your scanning range. Watch out for other people's attacks.

title: Relax Mini Games Collection
description: This is a collection of creative and fun mini-games. The game contains a variety of modes, you can DIY ice cream, have cooking for mooncakes, design a car of your favorite, and so on. You cant miss our game if you want to find some relaxation in your busy life.

title: Supermarket Cashier Simulator
description:
Practice being the best cashier in the supermarket. Become a mathematician by calculating and entering prices of grocery items and giving change to your customers. By playing you also improve your mathematical skills with the calculator in the game. This game is suitable to be played by adults or teenagers.

With the supermarket cashier game, you will improve your skills and concentration in calculating and also increase your level of accuracy.

title: Jailbreak Assault
description: In Jailbreak Assault, you’re a prisoner on a daring escape mission. Starting in your cell, you grab a key dropped by a guard, unlock the door, and arm yourself with a baton. Battle guards, destroy vital documents, disable cameras, and unlock new areas as you fight your way through each mission. Eventually, you’ll secure a gun from the armory, using it to take on the heavily guarded outer perimeter. Can you make it to freedom?

title: Shadowman Runner
description:
Shadowman Runner is a dark, atmospheric endless runner inspired by the minimalist silhouette style of Limbo and the fast-paced arcade spirit of games like Soul Knight and Alto’s Adventure. Set in a mysterious black-and-shadow world, the game challenges your reflexes, timing, and focus.
You play as a lone runner sprinting through a dangerous jungle landscape. Your goal is simple yet addictive: run as far as you can, collect potions to score points, and survive.

title: Fashion Stylist Salon Makeover
description: Do you want to create your own fashion styles? Join our best hair salon simulator game and enjoy the utmost fun. You will act as a fashion stylist who does haircuts, hairstyling, and skin care. Welcome customers with different requirements and use your hairstyling skills to make them satisfied and happy!

title: Spring Tile Master
description: Welcome to Spring Tile Master! Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of spring as you match tiles adorned with blooming flowers, colorful leaves, and charming insects. Draw tiles from the board to form sets of three. Keep up to 9 tiles in your stack and shuffle when needed. Collect all tiles to unlock new levels. Enjoy the enchanting springtime adventure and become the ultimate Spring Tile Master!

title: Rich Choice Run
description: Rich Choice Run is a fun swipe runner where every decision shapes your final lifestyle. Slide left and right to pick the best “boyfriend” choices and grab expensive items along the way. Your choices build your value and status—choose wisely, because one bad pick can ruin your chance.

title: Geometry Wave Hero
description: Geometry Wave Hero is an exciting rhythm-based game that takes players on a thrilling journey through a vibrant color world. This game offers a unique twist on the classic Geometry Dash formula, focusing exclusively on the wave game mode. Players must navigate their wave through a series of challenging obstacles, using simple one-touch mechanics to control its movement.

title: Tile Sort - Match 3
description: Tile Sort - Match 3 is an addictive match-3 puzzle game where your task is to sort and match identical tiles on the board. The game combines classic match-3 gameplay with elements of sorting, adding an extra layer of strategy and logic. Move tiles, creating combinations of three or more identical tiles to clear the board.

title: Steal Brainrot Monsters!
description:
Step into a world of fun, charm, and Italian flair with Buy Cute and Funny Animals! From the tiny and delightful Nubini Pizzanini to the rare and majestic Tralalelo Tralala and the playful Los Tralalelitos, there’s no shortage of adorable creatures to collect.

Build your very own cozy base, place your animals in it, and make them feel right at home. In return, they’ll reward you with coins, which you can use to unlock even more animals and exciting upgrades.

title: Amazing Airplane Racer
description: Amazing Airplane Racer revolutionizes the airborne gaming experience by combining high-speed plane racing with strategic special skills. Maneuver through challenging tracks while collecting power-ups like turbo boosts and shields to outsmart opponents. With stunning graphics and intense multiplayer action, the game delivers an adrenaline-packed aerial competition where skill and strategy take center stage. Are you ready to dominate the skies and become the ultimate airborne champion?

title: GT Traffic Racer
description: Skid the wheels of 6 awesome cars with insane speed limits and drive them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills?

title: Digit Shooter
description: Digit Shooter! plays like a vertical-version shooting running arcade game. With 3D green numbers, you can launch green numbers to shoot green numbers and numbered walls. You can shoot them and collect them to make your number bigger. Don't waste bullets and time on red walls while avoiding them. When you reach the finish line, try to focus on one line to shoot, then you will collect more rewards

title: Obby Escape: Prison Rat Dance
description: Obby Escape: Prison Rat Dance is an exhilarating adventure game that merges the thrill of intricate prison escape challenges with the dynamic agility required in parkour. Assume the role of a resourceful rat striving to escape the strict surveillance of a heavily fortified prison. Find your way through elaborate mazes and overcome diverse, challenging obstacles as you plot your daring prison escape.

title: Color Bump Dancer
description: Color Bump Dancer is a fun and casual puzzle game, with cool colors that greatly enhance the fun of the game. Various classic levels are waiting for you to pass, and there are also various gameplay options, don't miss the game!

title: Grand Clash Arena
description:
Grand Clash Arena is a unique war game that offers an action-packed experience.

Key Features of the Game:

-Epic Combat Experience: Showcase your mastery against opponents by using every object at your disposal.

-Drop Weapons and Surprises: Alter the flow of the game with surprise drops from the sky. Surprise your opponents with powerful weapons that suddenly appear and gain an advantage.

Grand Clash Arena offers a unique gaming experience that combines the art of war and strategy.

title: My Arcade Center
description: My Arcade Center is a fast-paced management game where you build and expand your own arcade. Earn tokens by day, upgrade machines by night, hire staff, use coin bots, and handle freeloaders and vandals. Unlock new machines, optimize layouts, manage customer behavior, and progress through 9 handcrafted maps for long-term growth.

title: Hexagon
description: Embark on a merging frenzy with "Hexagon"! Place hexagonal tiles on the board, watch them merge and multiply. Create chain reactions and earn points as you strategically fill the hexagonal grid. Can you reach the ultimate merge and trigger the explosive power of 512? Play now and test your merging skills!

title: Grow a Garden 3D
description:
Welcome to Grow a Garden, a fun and peaceful game where you plant seeds and grow magical trees! ?
Explore different seasons, customize your character, and watch your garden grow bigger every day.
Every seed is special and every garden is unique!

title: Color Rings Block Puzzle
description: Color Rings Block Puzzle is a fun and addictive mobile game that challenges your problem-solving skills and reflexes. The game is simple to play but difficult to master, making it perfect for both casual and hardcore gamers.

title: Super Football Fever
description: We bring you an unprecedentedly realistic soccer experience with smooth motion-captured animations and lifelike 3D graphics that make you feel like you're on a top-tier league field. Build your dream team, sign superstars, and win matches with precise tactical arrangements. Whether it's quick short passes or stunning long-range goals, you can do it all with ease at your fingertips.

title: Snake Masters
description:
Control a small worm and get ready to reach the other side of the screen. Enjoy a puzzle inspired by the classic Snake, where you must guide the worm to the other side of the apple and escape safely. Will you be smart enough to beat all thirty levels?

Game Features
- Special crawling mechanics.
- Challenge your brain.
- Tons of interesting puzzles.
- Easy controls.

title: Grukkle Onslaught
description: Grukkle Onslaught: Defend the blue portal in this thrilling tower defense game! Strategically place towers to fend off waves of enemies and protect your gateway. Master strategy and quick thinking to emerge victorious. Play now and prove your skills!

title: Dark Myth: Monkey Merge
description: Merge warriors, build your army, and fight through hordes of monsters as the Monkey King! Your master and companions have been captured — combine strategy and action to rescue them all. From Common to Legendary, every merge makes you stronger.

title: Twisted Rope
description: Get ready for a mind-bending challenge! ? Twisted Rope Puzzle 3D is a captivating game that will put your problem-solving skills to the test. Dive into a colorful world of tangled ropes and work your way through increasingly complex puzzles.

title: Draw To Smash!
description:
Draw To Smash — a logic puzzle game in which you should draw a line, scribbles, figures or doodles to smash all the bad eggs.

Draw To Smash is an amusing logic game that will test your IQ and raise your intellectual abilities to a new level. Plan every step, estimate a possible outcome and build tactical strategies. Solve logical puzzles, pass interesting levels and open bonus levels.

title: Capybara Go!
description: Enter the wonderful world of Capybara. In Capybara Go, begin a strategic adventure. You'll be forming and commanding your own little Capybara army. Defeat your opponents and conquer everything through strategy and combat. Lay out your Capybara's to take advantage of each one's strengths and use strategy to defeat powerful enemies.

title: Bus Color Jam
description: Welcome to Bus Color Jam, a lively and colorful online game that challenges your coordination and quick thinking. Guide passengers to the right buses by matching their colors and keeping the station running smoothly. Every level brings new challenges that test your timing and attention. It’s a fun mix of strategy and reflexes — easy to learn, satisfying to master, and completely free to play on both your phone and computer.

title: Soccer Snakes
description: Two wild, clumsy snakes competing in a soccer match is the perfect mix of humor, chaos, and sports. Play solo or share your keyboard with a friend and score some 'hiss-terical' fun with Soccer Snakes!

title: G Wagon City Driver
description: Dive into city driving with four game modes. Navigate busy morning streets, managing fuel and realistic traffic. Venture beyond the city to tackle rugged offroad terrain. Stunning morning graphics bring the city and landscapes to life, while unpredictable pedestrians and police chases add excitement. Customize your G-Wagon's look and performance, and enjoy the ride with your loyal dog. Whether evading cops or exploring trails, G-Wagon City Driver offers a thrilling experience.

title: Fireside Solitaire
description:
Fireside Solitaire is a cozy card puzzle that combines logic and relaxation by the warmth of a crackling fire.
Place cards in sequence — one rank higher or lower than the current open card — to clear all columns.
Think ahead: once the draw pile runs out, it can’t be reshuffled, and the game ends.
Enjoy calm music, soft light, and the comforting atmosphere of a winter evening by the fireplace.

title: Fish Master: Go Fish
description:
You’d think that a game called Go Fish would be based on the classic card game, but you’d be wrong. Fish Master – Go Fish is all about taking your ship to the middle of the sea and fishing until your boat can’t hold any more fish!

There are dozens of different fish types in the sea, and it’s your job to reel them all in! As you catch fish, your library of fish types will fill up, so you’ll always know what’s left to catch.

title: People Playground! Ragdoll Arena!
description:
People Playground! Ragdoll Arena! is a fun physics-based adventure where chaos is the goal. Tap and hold objects to move them, then release to throw them at the doll.

Your goal:
Inflict maximum damage and destroy your doll using everything at your disposal. Drop a car on his head, throw a rock at him, or throw him off a cliff. Every action triggers a reaction, so experiment with different ways to destroy. Sometimes there will be multiple dolls: twice the targets, twice the strategies!

title: Wave Chic Ocean Fashion Frenzy
description: Welcome to the game in which every new tide carries a new wave of style! Help two girlfriends to celebrate the new beach season with dignity. Each of the girls has her own unique sense of fashion and style. Combine swimsuits with a variety of accessories to create unique summer looks. And don't forget to pick up a surfboard or a sapboard. Get ready for adventures on the water and to become the most stylish on the whole coast!

title: Math Crossword Puzzle - Genius Edition
description: Challenge your brain with Math Crossword, the perfect mix of logic puzzles and number games! Solve clever math equations in a crossword-style grid by placing the correct numbers into the right spots. Each level sharpens your brain with fun and rewarding challenges that test your addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division skills.

title: Troll The Teacher
description:
Laugh and prank the teacher in this fun school game!

Have you ever dreamed of playing a prank on your teacher? Now you have a chance! In this game, you will become a student who arranges funny pranks right during the lesson. Use the most unexpected "tools", upgrade them and watch the funny reactions of the teacher!

title: Brainrot Boing Boing Merge
description:
Welcome to Brainrot Boing Boing Merge – a charming merge puzzle game where adorable creatures meet polished gameplay and juicy physics!

Merge. Match. Maximize
Satisfying Effects & Lively Details
Unlockable Skins System
Relaxing Yet Strategic

If you love satisfying merges, juicy feedback, and charming characters, this game is for you. Play now and see what creature you’ll create next!

title: Beauty World and Fashion Stylist
description: Play stylist game just now! This is the most fashionable salon for girls, where you can not only do makeup, but also dress characters in nice outfits! Change accessories, hairstyles and interior, take screenshot and save stylish images to the gallery!

title: Ninja Time
description: Immerse yourself in the world of samurai and ninjas in Ninja Time. Stretch your bamboo stick to navigate increasingly complex levels, collecting coins for new ninja skins. Experience Japan's martial arts era and become the ultimate ninja legend!

title: SWAT & Plants vs Zombies
description: "SWAT & Plants vs Zombies" is an engaging tower defense strategy game where you can upgrade and unlock new members of the SWAT squad as well as plants. Together, they will stand against waves of advancing zombies.

title: Animal in Rails!
description:
An exciting puzzle game about delivering animals to a trader's base

Connect and disconnect railways around the world to help each animal reach its home.

Install, remove, and redirect connections so that wagons can safely connect to the locomotive. But be careful and don't let them collide with each other!

Delay trains by using railway barriers. Change the tracks to redirect the wagons in different directions. Pick up new pets along the way and face even more challenges along the way!

title: Block Digger
description: Dig, Click, and Get Rich! In Block Digger, every tap brings you closer to fortune! Smash stones, collect coins and crystals, and upgrade your mine to skyrocket your earnings. Unlock new mines, chase achievements, and build your mining empire. It's easy, fun, and totally addictive—start digging today! ⛏️

title: Digger Fighter in the Maze
description: Digger Fighter in the Maze is an action-packed adventure game that takes you deep into a mysterious underground labyrinth filled with secrets, dangers, and treasures. Step into the shoes of a brave digger fighter as you tunnel your way through winding mazes, uncover hidden paths, and gather valuable resources. Along the way, you'll meet and recruit powerful allies, each with unique abilities that can help you overcome obstacles and defeat fierce enemies.

title: TimeWarriors
description:
Lead your army to glory through the ages! Embark on an epic journey through history. From primitive battles of the Stone Age to the futuristic wars of the future — become the greatest commander the world has ever known.

Become a great commander and lead your army to victory! Play “Time Warriors” now!

title: Screw Color Sorting Master
description: Screw Color Sorting Master is a relaxing yet addictive puzzle game! Sort vibrant colored screws onto poles by moving them strategically—same colors must stack together. With simple controls, hundreds of challenging levels, and satisfying visuals, sharpen your brain and become the ultimate sorting master!

title: Brainrot Merge
description:
Merge adorably weird Italian brainrot characters! 
Combine them to unlock rare (and even weirder) species. 
Build the ultimate brainrot paradise!

title: Stickman Rocket
description: You have a powerful cannon loaded with Stickman Ragdols which you must shoot far to reach your target! Solve all kinds of challenges as you collect gems, avoid obstacles and control your throws to reach the targets in each level. Try not to bump into obstacles along the way and use all the raggedy characters you need to have fun with these amazing challenges - good luck!

title: The Sort Agency
description: You are the head of the best object sorting agency. Your goal is to bring order and cleanliness to the world. On the many levels you will be able to test your attentiveness and tactical thinking. Look for the right items in a pile of other items. But keep track of how many items you already have in your hands!

title: Idle Firefighter 3D
description: Idle Firefighter 3D is a single player firefighter simulator game. You will play the role of a firefighter and it is your duty to save the survivors from the fire. Here, new emergencies are constantly occurring and you need to be on standby and must put out the fires as soon as possible! The fire extinguisher is your friend, if the props run out, you will not be able to put out the fire.

title: Pubg Hack
description: Experience the ultimate shooting adventure. In Pubg Hack, you step into the battlefield as an elite soldier, exploring massive maps and engaging in fierce combat. Select a location to land and begin searching for supplies.

title: Egg Dash
description: Crack the code and dash your way to victory in Egg Dash, an egg-citing version of the rhythm-based game genre! Jump, dodge, and conquer egg-cellent obstacles in this fast-paced adventure.

title: TB Avataria Life Girl
description:
Hey, how about helping me decorate my house? You need to decorate my home beautifully, buy me nice clothes, and feed me. Let's get started — right now, I have an empty house, and we need to furnish it together. Let's make it look organized and cozy!
